abstract: Software engineering (SE) has recently seen an increase in the use of deep learning. Nevertheless, numerous unresolved issues ought to be investigated. articleTitle: Design and Development of 5 DOF Bio-Inspired Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This research article introduces an innovative modular Robotic Arm that draws inspiration from biological systems and is exclusively derived and constructed by an evolutionary process from a mechanical stem cell. Drawing inspiration from stem cells, this proposal introduces a distinct mechanical stem cell that differs from existing robot "cells" or "molecules". The aim is to advance the field by creating motorized cells, bones, and a muscle based on the Sarrus linking mechanism. The suggested skeleton and muscle system create a bio-inspired, segmental, five-DOF robotic arm. Then, the non-linear transcendental calculations that govern the kinematics of the robotic arm are solved using an arithmetic iterative approach based on an optimization strategy. Next, an arithmetical sample of the future arm for the robot is shown, complete with imitations that showcase the arm's workstation opposite kinematics. Initial motion and manipulation experiments are also performed, and a robotic arm prototype is created and combined with low-level regulator systems. The findings show that the innovative robotic arm performs as expected and has the benefits of being cheaper, taking up less space, being smaller in size and having a more straightforward construction.

articleTitle: IoT Based ECG Monitoring and Detection System Using Pan-Tompkins Algorithm and Ubidots Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized the healthcare industry by enabling real-time monitoring of patient vital signs. Electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring plays a crucial role in diagnosing cardiac abnormalities. In this research article, we propose an IoT-based ECG detection system that utilizes the Pan-Tompkins algorithm for accurate and reliable ECG signal processing. The system enables remote monitoring of ECG signals, facilitating early detection of cardiac anomalies and timely intervention. This article presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the proposed IoT-based ECG detection system, highlighting its effectiveness and potential impact on healthcare. This paper illustrates the implementation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in the healthcare domain, focusing on a proposed system for remotely monitoring the ECG of patients. The system's key components include the Arduino Uno, an ECG Sensor, and an IoT Cloud for real-time storage and visualization of ECG data. The primary goal of the system is to accurately measure the heart rate of distant patients and facilitate continuous monitoring of their ECG signals from a remote location.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques to Analysis Facial Expression and Gender Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Facial recognition in humans is essential for computers to connect with people. The ultimate objective is to instantly and reliably predict a person's gender, age, and facial expression. For example, one can use this knowledge to better understand human behaviour, diagnose mental illnesses, and develop artificial human expressions. automated human face recognition has just a few uses at the moment. articleTitle: Automated Traffic Management Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This study proposes an automated traffic management system that employs image processing techniques, as well as edge and object detection algorithms. The system’s primary goal is to improve traffic flow and alleviate congestion by automatically detecting and analyzing vehicles in real-time using strategically placed cameras. Edge detection algorithms are used to identify object boundaries in the images captured by the cameras. Object detection algorithms are then utilized to identify and classify vehicles based on their size, shape, and other features. Machine learning algorithms are also used to enhance vehicle detection and classification accuracy. The system’s processed data is utilized to dynamically manage traffic signals, control traffic flow, and provide alternate routes to bypass congested areas. The proposed system has the potential to enhance traffic efficiency, reduce travel time, and promote road safety.

articleTitle: Camera Ready Summary A Study and Analysis of Campus Recruitment Parameters and Selection Process

abstract: Recent years, campus recruitment is the major part of educational institutions. articleTitle: COME: Collection Organizing Managing Evaluating the Projects using Machine Learning with Procrastination Index

articleTitle: Application of 5R’s of Sustainability in Hotel Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The hotel industry is shifting its perspective towards eco-friendly practices and designing and implementing applications that are environmentally-friendly. However, hotels’ considerations of refuse, reuse, reduce, recycle, and repurpose (5R’s of environmental sustainability) is not abundant in their policies. The present study has examined the implementation of the 5R’s of sustainability in the hotel industry in a selected area of Rajasthan. According to a thorough review of the literature, no research is has been conducted on the application of 5R’s in five-star, four-star, and three-star hotels in the state of Rajasthan. The data was collected using questionnaire containing ten questions and was analysed using using mean, analysis of variance (ANOVA), leaner regression and F-Test with the help of statistical package for social sciences (SPSS). The results suggest hotels have been performing well on the aspects studied except for variations of reduce.

articleTitle: A Flexible Wearable Antenna On-Body and Implant Communications Using UWB Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This paper presents a prototype of a UWB antenna specifically designed for biomedical applications. The proposed antenna features a circular radiating element and achieves enhanced impedance matching characteristics through coplanar waveguide (CPW) feeding. The antenna design utilizes a high-frequency substrate, Rogers XT 8000, known for its flexibility, with a permittivity of 3.3 and a loss tangent of 0.002. The suitability of the proposed antenna for on-body biomedical applications is emphasized, and the antenna model is created using the CST tool. Through simulations, it is observed that the circular radiating element of the UWB antenna effectively radiates within the frequency range of 2.39 to 6.98 GHz. Additionally, the paper presents results pertaining to the radiation pattern, gain, reflection coefficient, and surface current distribution of the proposed antenna.

articleTitle: Collaborating the AI With IoT to Develop Cyber-Physical System to Estimate the Quality of Metal Casting by Using R Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Significant time and money savings may be realised if it were possible to foresee internal faults in metal casting immediately after the casting process. As was discussed before, the goal is achieved by the allocation of fewer resources to later phases like machining and the provision of adaptable scheduling. CPPS is accurate in meeting the standards above. This study explores CPPS (Cyber-Physical Production Systems) in a real-world manufacturing setting for quality prediction of metal castings and process control. The framework was first designed for use in the CPPS architecture of metal casting manufacturing, where it would aid in quality forecasting and operational management.The framework explains how different types of technology, and simulations to improve teamwork. Then, a depiction of the concrete business’s key process parameter system (or CPPS) was unveiled. The temperature has a significant impact on casting quality; hence casting machines are equipped with temperature sensors and internet connection devices. Typically, IoT data is stored in the NoSQL database HBase, while data preparation is handled using the lightning-fast processing and analysis tool Spark. Several machine learning methods were used to make accurate quality forecasting. R was used to analyse how well each method performed. A CPPS dashboard is used to showcase the overall system’s effectiveness. Complex abstract models are used in most CPPS studies at present. This research provides an in-depth examination of existing architectural frameworks, practical examples of their use, and analytical approaches.

articleTitle: AI Based Data Augmentation Process Used to Find the Defect in Injection Molding
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Automatic quality examination is now receiving attention as a vital element of the industry 4.o. However, because of the variety of products, challenges associated with creating uniformly high-quality product pictures, and short cycle durations, injection molding technologies have not gotten much attention in this field of study. In this work, we suggested an injection molding defect inspection method for edge intelligence. The data imbalance and scarcity issues faced by small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) are addressed via data augmentation, implemented the unique technique of the injection process, and evaluated effectiveness of the created AI model. The suggested model’s accuracy was more than 90%, demonstrating the system’s viability for use in the real world.

articleTitle: Multiparameterized Inception-V3 Convolution Neutral Network for Liver Lesion Classification and lesion staging using CT images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Liver Cancer is highest cause of cancer death all over the world due to its high morbidity and mortality. Risk factor associated with liver cancer includes, cirrhosis fibrosis and hepatitis B and C. Liver cancer is highly challenging to diagnosis in an early stage due to less symptoms tumor located deeply into body. Machine learning architecture is high implemented for diagnosing disease in earlier stage and monitoring the progress of the disease. However those architecture are time consuming and error prone due to complex features on Couinaud segment annotation. Therefore, new methodology for early identification of liver cancer is required to compute the liver condition and cure disease before the liver deterioration. In order to handle those challenges, a new deep learning mechanism entitled as multiparameterized Inception V3 Convolution Neural Network is proposed for liver lesion classification and lesion staging. Initially image preprocessing using median filter has been implemented to improve the results of the image segmentation through noise removal. Next, global thresholding based segmentation has been employed to pre-processed images to segment the region of the interest and lesion boundaries effectively. Those segmented image has been employed to fast kernel discriminant analysis which acts feature extraction technique to extract the multiple lesion feature of the liver lesion region. Extracted feature has been employed to the model of the generate the learning model on the employing multiparameterized Inception V3 Convolution Neural Network Classifier for liver lesion classification and staging of disease on basis of feature values. multiparameterized Inception V3 Convolution Neural Network Classifier contains the convolution layer for feature map generation, max pooling layer to obatin the high level features and fully connected layer uses softmax layer to discriminate the feature map into liver lesion classes such as hepatocellular carcinoma, hemangioma and liver metastasis. Further proposed model reduces the network complexity and enhances the computing efficiency using loss layer. Experimental results of the current model is verified in the MATLAB software on using LiTs dataset which contains 1500 CT images. Performance analysis of the proposed architecture generates the disease classes such as cirrhosis, fibrosis, basal hepatocellular carcinoma, hemangioma and liver metastasis with 97.75% accuracy, 96.46 specificity and 98.4% sensitivity respectively on comparing against conventional classifiers

articleTitle: The Hidden Threat: Detecting API Hooking in Memory Forensics Using Open-Source Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: API hooking is a prevalent technique utilized by malicious actors to compromise the integrity and security of computer systems. Through the interception and manipulation of system function calls, API hooking allows unauthorized code execution, granting attackers control over critical processes. Detecting and understanding such hooking attempts are of paramount importance for effective memory forensics, enabling the identification and mitigation of potential threats. This research paper presents an in-depth investigation into API hooking by injecting hooks into the Notepad application. Subsequently, the memory of the infected system is captured and analyzed using two open-source tools, Volatility and MemProcFs. A comprehensive comparative analysis between these tools is conducted to assess their efficiency in detecting and analyzing API hooking. The experimental results shed light on the significance of memory forensics for combatting API hooking and offer valuable insights to forensic analysts and cybersecurity practitioners.

articleTitle: Intelligent Smart Power Grid Intrusion Detection System Using Preprocessing and Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In a smart grid, intrusion detection is a key task for ensuring the network’s safety and reliability. In this research paper, we present an innovative technique for data preparation in smart grid intrusion detection that employs MDS (Multi-Dimensional Scaling), Locally Linear Embedding (LLE), and t-distributed Stochastic Neighbour Embedding (t-SNE). The preprocessed data is then utilized to train a CNN (Convolution Neural Network) for classification. The model’s performance is assessed using accuracy, precision and recalls determining its usefulness for identifying intrusions. The t-SNE-based preprocessing increases the CNN’s capacity to distinguish between normal and invasive events, resulting in greater accuracy, precision, and recall scores.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning based Deep Neural Network for Autonomous identification of Brain Tumor Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Due to the significant role of brain in controlling as well as coordinating multi-functions of body, it is considered as a complex and intricate organ due to which any damage to the tissues lying within brain can cause serious problem for an individual if not identified and treated timely. Though most of the medical professionals ask their patients to undergo magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography etc. which further rely on experts for providing interpretations to identify presence of abnormal growth of tissues. Thus, asymptotic behaviour at an early stage may cause them to give false interpretations especially when tumor growth is too small and doesn’t get identified at initial stage. Developing computer-assisted system can aid radiologists to overcome this issue while making any decisions in this regard for achieving more accurate and efficient results while diagnosing brain tumor disease in healthcare as compared to the conventional approaches. In this work, extended version of residual network namely ResNet152 has been integrated with support vector machines for extracting significant features and distinguishing infected images from healthy brain images respectively. Thus, proposed model is trained well following transfer learning process and validated on unseen data after which it gained 97.50% accuracy, 98.33% sensitivity, 96.67% specificity, 96.72% precision and 97.52% F1-Score due to which this hybrid model performed effectively while diagnosing brain tumor rather than existing state-of-art approaches.

articleTitle: Morphology-Based Machine Learning Mechanism for Unsupervised Framework Prediction Using Statistical Segmentation on Blood Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: White blood cells are a component of the immune system that defends the body from pathogens. The most typical blood malignancy that can be fatal is leukaemia. It happens because the bone marrow produces a lot of immature WBCs, which kill healthy cells. It is essential to detect the morphology of the cells that are immature because it can bring down the number of people requiring treatment. Techniques based on Deep-learning (DL) models-based segmentation and classifications have recently been invented but they still have certain drawbacks.The data used to detect leukaemia is first pre processed, then segmented and the features are extracted and finally classified. Recent deep learning approaches and difficulties in detecting leukaemia are described in this article. These techniques are useful for more precise leukaemia identification and for examining microscopic blood smear images.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Technology Used in the Energy and Power Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The process of creating a digital replica of a physical object, known as a digital twin, allows for the study of twin data. Additionally, the transfer learning technique may be utilized for transferring the attributes of the digital twin to the physical item, enabling further analysis. This study primarily examines the use of digital twinning technologies within the energy and power sector. To address the issue of energy conservation and control in building energy demand terminals, the implementation of a fuzzy adaptable Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) control algorithm is proposed. This algorithm is utilized to simulate the indoor Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system and the lighting system, to mitigate the adverse impact of weather conditions, time-varying factors, and unpredictable elements on the interior temperature and illumination intensity. When comparing the fuzzy adaptable PID controller to the standard PID controller, it becomes evident that the former exhibits quicker adjustment, more accurate output duty ratio, and superior control effectiveness.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi-Based Smart Energy Meter Using Internet of Things with Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: There are numerous issues with existing domestic energy metre reading systems, including challenges in constructions, too narrow bandwidths, too low rates, poor realtime, and slow two-way communications, among others. This paper used wireless technology for an Automatic Meter Reading device to solve the problems described above. The proposed approach uses IoT to communicate between the Electricity Board portion and the user section, allowing the customer's electricity usage and bill information to be transmitted. The customer receives information about the bill amounts and payments through the Internet of Things. Over the past decade, the Indian power sector has accomplished a great deal in the areas of policy reforms, private sector participation in generation and transmission, and the development of new manufacturing technology and capabilities; however, there is still a great deal more to accomplish and a number of obstacles to overcome before the opportunities can be capitalized on. As a result, the private sector has been very active in investing in various parts of the value chain. Nevertheless, the vast majority of engagement by private investors has taken place in the generating sector. This trend has been driven by de-licensing of generation, fiscal incentives for large-scale capacity increases, and competitive buying of electricity. As a result of the changes implemented in the industry, the structure of the market has been transformed from one that is vertically integrated to one that is competitive. The effectiveness of the market has been increased throughout time as a consequence of several rules and regulations that have had the intended effect. Mobility in the power market has risen, and so has the number of competitors; legislation has produced a competitive market place, which will in the future totally open the market in the power sector.

articleTitle: Enhanced Play FAIR Cipher
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Security plays a crucial role in the field of communication between any two devices. Design of complex unpredictable keys are essential to make the communication more secure in various dimensions of data such as small, medium, and large. However, modern portable and IoT peripheral devices have limited computational power that hinders the process of key generation. Further, their communication system does not have strong protection. To overcome this, we propose a model to encrypt and decrypt the messages which requires less computational power. This can be used in modern portable and IoT peripheral devices of various data lengths. The proposed method also provides additional security through octal and hexadecimal play fair cipher. The proposed model is relatively harder to crack when compared to play fair cipher. The principle of the proposed design is similar to that of play fair cipher, however it uses a completely different cipher matrix of dimensions 8x8, 16x16 and a different replacement rule as well. This model supports the design of a multi-character encryption cipher. Here, a plaintext is taken as input and is transformed into corresponding cipher text. The proposed design is applied to various communication systems with additional security compared to play fair cipher between devices of portable and IoT peripheral devices of different data lengths. Since it is implemented with octal number, hexadecimal number and hence named enhanced play fair cipher.

articleTitle: Analysis of Badminton Track Using Computer Vision Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: For both young and old, badminton is a sport. A badminton robot must be created for the real-time dynamic tracking of badminton travelling at high speed in order to swiftly and accurately capture the dynamic route of the game. We examine the impact of gravity and aerodynamic forces on badminton flight in the air in this essay. Experiments are used to analyze the key elements influencing the badminton shuttle’s flight path. A steady-state flight model for badminton is created using the badminton flight trajectory recorded by a high-speed camera, along with a spin model. Considering that both model and measurement mistakes can occur during the badminton trajectory prediction process particle filtering is an inference model based on Monte Carlo sampling that is more suited to badminton state estimation since it does not require a priori knowledge of state transfer. Therefore, in this study, particle filtering is used to follow the badminton player’s path. Following experimental validation, the algorithm is quite good at following the badminton ball’s motion route.

articleTitle: Monitor and Control Electricity for Home Appliance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Electricity is a vital part of modern life; therefore, it is crucial to learn how to utilize it safely. Over time, current systems for domestic power regulation have been analyzed with an eye toward improvement. However, existing Power Monitoring and Switching (PMAS) methods have a greater error rate and cannot be remotely monitored. As a result, this research suggests a SMACS for monitoring and controlling domestic appliances. The relevance of the application is in its ability to monitor the power consumption of home appliances via the use of hardware and IoT techniques. An Arduino UNO, a liquid-crystal display (LCD), an ACS812 current sensor module, some relays, and some AC sources all go into making the prototype of the suggested system. The software library is mined for parts, and identical simulation and prototype results are identified. Due to its absence from the system, the ESP9266 WiFi module has been included in the design. Thing-speak is used to record the information in the cloud. Data is accessed using a mobile app (Virtuoso), so it may be visualized numerically and graphically. Through the use of mobile apps, this research offers consumers a simple mechanism for keeping tabs on and adjusting the power usage of standard home equipment. The results demonstrate that the present Power Monitoring and Switching (PMAS) system produces 8.8% of current errors for the hairdryer appliance, whereas the suggested system gives just 1.6% of existing faults.

articleTitle: Mathematical Evaluation of Predictive Analytics in Business World

abstract: The level of competition in the economy grew at a rate several times faster than in previous periods as new technologies developed.
