articleTitle: Machine Learning approach for Multi-Page Document Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In current technologically advanced era, everything is digitized, or tend to be digital. Segregating documents into different groups and classifying them based on the content similarity and context correlations is a challenging task. Document classification, studied as a part of information retrieval, finds its application with efficient data organization, fruitful search for information and redundant data management.The proposed work - Machine Learning approach for Multi Page Document Classification (ML-MPDC), uses machine learning approach to efficiently analyse multi-page document, and predict to which category the document belongs to. The proposed model uses supervised learning approach, and employs text vectorization algorithms such as Doc2Vec and regression algorithms such as linear regression to predict the document classes. The MLMPDC project has been skillfully designed and executed, leveraging machine learning algorithms to automate document sorting based on their respective classes. This implementation significantly benefits businesses by reducing workforce costs and minimizing the time required for document sorting. The model’s performance substantiates its effectiveness in achieving these objectives.

articleTitle: Integrity of Code and IoT Validation of Resource Utilization in Micro Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Cybersecurity for the Internet of Things is gaining more and more attention as the number of IoT devices has increased and the number of attack stargeting these devices continues to grow exponentially. However, the significant focus areas for security measures have been guaranteeing services’ constant availability and protecting users’ private data. But code integrity is not receiving the attention it deserves because these devices lack the horsepower to provide more robust safeguards. This issue necessitates more study into adapting standard procedures for code integrity to IoT gadgets. This paper describes a virtual machine-based technique for ensuring the correct execution of code on the Internet of Things. The feasibility of a virtual machine tailored to safeguard software during firmware upgrades is demonstrated here. The suggested method’s low resource requirements on popular microcontrollers have been verified experimentally. The acquired findings prove that this secured technique for coding may work in practice.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Object Oriented Software Estimation: A Case Of Reusability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The software development stages supported by deep learning techniques in view of the collection of software engineering promises, it is essential to see the current software engineering requirements helped through deep learning, by seeing it various supports experts find the feasible to use deep learning information to deliver commercial software by considering functional and nonfunctional requirements. A Reusability assessment model for object oriented design particularly for design phase of development life cycle has been developed in this research paper with the help of deep learning technique. The developed system relates the Reusability orientated diagram qualities with software maintenance requirements and also connects feasibility with Reusability. No such model has been currently available in the literature review that measures Reusability of OO diagram through bringing practicality into consideration utilizing deep learning. The proposed model overcomes any barrier among object orientated outline qualities, practicality and Reusability. Proposed efforts works in order to improve the overall software design quality by considering the quality key attributes especially reusability of software design at initial stage of development life cycle. Finally in view of the above truth proposed model has been developed and validated with the help of class diagrams.

articleTitle: Integrating a Novel Scheme for Enhanced Energy Efficiency in Human Body Area Networks (HBAN) with Mobile Sink and Cluster Head selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: From energy consumption perspective in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), path routing of sensor nodes is a difficult and challenging task. In routing protocols Clustering techniques performs a vital role to lengthen the stability and network lifetime. In this paper, routing protocols is designed that emphasize on coverage-keeping and connection-maintaining. As routing sensed information can harm humans so sensor nodes are carefully placed in populated areas. This is the only way one can achieve maximize civic lifetime with complete protection. To achieve this in WSN network cluster head, the problem here can be named as a gateway-master and cluster selection. The proposed work makes use of cluster head selection technique on Human Body Network by implementing it in Mobile networks. The assumption is made that the receiving node can be positioned outside and inside the monitoring area, and cluster master node can be chosen to collect all uncover places.

articleTitle: Blockchain Smart Contracts Suitability for Safeguarding the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Blockchain research has attracted attention because of its fundamental properties, which offer security and privacy. Along with these it also provides integrity in absence on any dependable different party apart from the two. At first, only crypto currencies could be used with blockchain technology. However, with the introduction of Ethereum, which develops and executes the smart contracts. Smart contracts are minute computer programmes that work on blockchain technology. Apart from this, applications other than crypto currencies are under development and exploration. It was determined that a dearth of descriptive reviews is present on the application of smart contracts in protecting the Internet and IoT, despite the fact that a significant progress made towards enhancing Blockchain technology with an emphasis on the smart contracts has been developed. This study intends to locate and evaluate academic research on blockchain smart contracts for internet security.

articleTitle: Agriculture and Artificial Intelligence: Using Today’s AI to Address Traditional Farming methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Bound together Nations’ Food and Cultivating Affiliation (FAO) broadens that by 2050, there will be 2 billion extra people on the planet, yet the extended locale under agribusiness will simply make up 4% of that turn of events. New specialized advancements and solutions for current cultivation bottlenecks can be utilized to carry out more productive practices. As a representation of how cultivating has advanced over the long haul, it is feasible to utilize the immediate use of simulated intelligence (manmade consciousness) or machine knowledge all through the sector [1]. With man-made intelligence controlled cultivating arrangements, a rancher can accomplish more with less, increment quality, and fuel different rural areas with simulated intelligence. Additionally, it examines the issues that are typical in the future and computer-controlled thoughts for the future.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model used Efficiently to Manage the Smart Grid and Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: A new technology, a Smart Grid Management System (SGMS), explains how it uses machine learning algorithms to distribute power more effectively. This article overviews intelligent grid management systems, including their design, advantages, and problems. Machine learning methods, including decision trees, neural networks, and Support Vector Machines (SVM), are also discussed in this study as they are employed in intelligent grid management systems. Increased efficiency, less waste, enhanced dependability, and decreased expenses are a few benefits of using deep learning techniques in intelligent energy systems for management. Protection of data, Security, and capacity are only some issues that arise when applying machine learning techniques to innovativegrid management systems. The report finishes with a discussion of potentialnext steps for machine research learning-based intelligent control systems for grids.

articleTitle: Human Age Estimation using Face Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In current era, deep neural network based age classification is dominating over the traditional classification methods using face images. The amount of facial photographs available in the world has soared due to the rising ubiquity of cameras and the rise of selfies. As a result, there is a growing interest in predicting a person’s age from facial images. This study focuses on age estimation using an individual’s still facial photos. The authors have built Custom CNN model and trained the model using UTKFace dataset, the performance is compared with pre-trained VGG16 and ResNet50 models for the same dataset. It has been shown that the effectiveness of the custom neural networks is better than the pretrained models for UTKFace dataset.

articleTitle: Spectrum Sensing-Optimized Data Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This article discusses spectrum sensing through Machine Learning with an emphasis on the cuckoo search optimization technique. Cognitive radio’s distribution of scarce resources among a growing number of users is a contemporary cause of spectrum scarcity. As a result, optimizing the radio spectrum is of the utmost importance. Spectrum sensing is one of the popular techniques for effectively using the spectrum. Machine learning-based detection is more significant than other Energy detection-based spectrum sensing approaches. To identify the optimal solution to the spectrum sensing issue, this investigation applies a cuckoo search-based minimization strategy. To analyze channels that have been affected by noise, the Gaussian function is often used. Spectrum sensing detection makes use of information classifiers that are based on the mean of each message. Both SVM and k-nearest-neighbor algorithms fall into this category. Average information-based SVM, KNN, and cuckoo search-based optimization outperform traditional energy detection-based methods and improve sensing accuracy with little loss.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Energy Efficient Clustering for Biomedical Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Biomedical Wireless Sensor Networks (BWSN) is major technique for Health Care applications for providing quality of life with minimum cost. To enforce the quality of medical care provided to the citizen, such networks should be integrated with existing network infrastructures. The requirement of quality of service should be concentrated on development stages and are monitored for the duration of network operation. The life time of the network is most relevant feature for ensuring the quality of medical care requirements. In order to increases the network lifetime, maintaining the remaining energy of each sensor node with reliable communication link throughout the network. An energy aware clustering for biomedical wireless sensor network (EACBWSN) is proposed for increasing the network lifetime by minimizing the energy consumption among sensor nodes and provides a reliable communication link between sensor nodes. The proposed algorithm efficiently prolong the lifetime of the network when compared with existing algorithm.

articleTitle: NLP-based Health Care- Hospital Recommendation Systems with Online Text Reviews by Patients Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Recent times, these recommendations based on reviews play a vital role in the service industry. The hospital is assessing its quality of service using these surveys or studies posted in online forums. The ongoing pandemic also played a vital role in making the online review more popular. These statistical data and visualization are informative in representing the views of patient satisfaction towards health service. As the size of data is large and it is of varied size and format it is difficult to get consolidated results. The users share their emotions and feelings through this review. So, it is a challenge to assess the emotions of the patients. Sentiment analysis using machine learning makes our work easy in evaluating the scores visually. The reviews are analyzed using natural language processing (NLP), and the sentiment of the studies is analysed as positive, negative, and neutral using polarity ranking, which in turn is converted as the recommendation system based on patient reviews. This paper aims to propose a new method of recommending the hospital based on the sentiment of the previous user review. The thought of the user is collected from the various hospitals. The proposed (Healthcare Recommendation System) HRS system has nearly 0.5 mean absolute error, which states that the proposed HRS system is significantly effective.

articleTitle: Image processing and Machine learning in Concrete Cube Crack detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Concrete cube testing plays a crucial role in various aspects of modern construction. The structural performance of concrete cubes under direct compressive stress can result in failure through concrete cube breakout. Failure modes related to concrete can be classified into two types: acceptable and non-acceptable, with further classification into various modes. However, most of the time approximately 80% to 90% of the cubes are inaccurately selected, leading to lower strength and sustainability of concrete. Moreover, the excessive usage of cement required due to these inaccuracies contributes to global warming and increases costs. To address these issues, this research aims to develop an industry 4.0 solution for the construction and civil engineering fields. The proposed solution will be reliable, efficient, and based on image processing techniques. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is used to detect and analyze cracks in concrete cubes. By examining the crack patterns, the damage area can be determined. By leveraging industry 4.0 technologies and advanced analysis techniques, this research aims to revolutionize the way concrete cube testing is conducted. The proposed solution will provide a reliable and efficient method for evaluating concrete cube quality, mitigating the negative impacts associated with inaccurate cube selection, and ultimately improving the performance and environmental sustainability of concrete in construction applications.

articleTitle: NLP and Deep Learning for Fake News Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The prevalence of social media and online news sources, which enable the quick dissemination of false information, has contributed significantly to the problem of fake news in recent years. To solve this issue, natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning techniques have been deployed to automatically identify and classify fake news articles. In this study, we applied four popular machine learning algorithms, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression, to classify fake news articles. The results showed that all four algorithms were capable of achieving high accuracy in classifying fake news articles, with Random Forest performing the best with an accuracy of 96.7%. To make the classification process more accessible to users, we developed a web interface using HTML, CSS, and Flask. The interface allows users to input news articles and receive a classification of whether the article is real or fake. The Flask server uses the machine learning models to classify the article and returns the result to the web application, which displays the classification result on the page using HTML and CSS. Furthermore, a comparative analysis of the four algorithms was conducted to determine which algorithm performed the best in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. The results indicated that Random Forest outperformed the other algorithms in both accuracy and computational efficiency, Overall, the combination of NLP techniques, machine learning algorithms, and web technologies can provide a powerful tool for combating fake news and promoting more accurate information dissemination.

articleTitle: Vehicular Data Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Vehicular Data Retrieval System is comprehensive research that focuses on collecting real-time data from vehicles and transmitting it to a remote server for storage and later visualization in a web application. The system incorporates advanced technologies such as GPS (Global Positioning System) for precise location tracking and data capturing. The primary aim of this research is to create an efficient and scalable solution that enables the retrieval of essential vehicular parameters including speed, engine temperature, fuel level, and coordinates. By harnessing this data, it becomes possible to visualize and analyze vehicle performance over time, leading to valuable insights for various applications, such as fleet management, transportation optimization, and environmental monitoring. This paper presents a detailed analysis of the research’s requirements, an extensive literature review, an evaluation of existing systems, and the proposed system design and implementation. Furthermore, the paper discusses testing methodologies, the achieved outcomes, and recommendations for future enhancements to further enrich the vehicular data retrieval and visualization system.

articleTitle: Grading of Academic Institutes using MCDM VIKOR Method Under Fuzzy Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This paper presents a framework that combines the VIKOR technique and the fuzzy sets theory to create scientific, rational, and methodical approach for gauging academic institutions within an uncertain or fuzzy environment. In this approach, triangular fuzzy integers are used as linguistic variables to effectively manage subjectivity, uncertainty, and vagueness. Furthermore, the method tackles the complexities of multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM), where-in set of several another possibility are evaluated based on multiple criteria, offering a comprehensive solution to this challenging process. There are many MCDM methods, this paper considers on of the MCDM method known as VIKOR method, also called as (VlseKriterijumska Optimizacija I Kompromisno Resenje) in Serbian. This study takes into account four evaluation criteria viz., Faculty, Research, Alumni interaction and Faculty_Students ratio as four parameters to evaluate 5 academic institutes. The final grading of academic institutes will be based on 3 experts opinion.

articleTitle: Development of a Framework to Digitalize the Data Flow Network between Manufacturer and Customer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Value Chain Management enables proper flow of information that is critical to supply chain performance as it offers the underpinning on which transactions are executed by supply chain processes hence enabling managers to make decisions. In recent trades information plays a significance role, which lets managers to know customer needs, inventory, stock and when should finished goods to be shipped. Information forms a transparent platform resulting in increased supply chain visibility which helps Managers to take decisions on right time. Sharing information is considered as a crucial process for supply chain amalgamation and transparency within the supply chain team, that offers prospects for managers to efficiently propose and plan the strategies and to react appropriately to the precise information. In today’s digital era, revolutionizing to digital supply chain has major challenge of sharing information among stakeholders. Information sharing is the process that assists as a crucial tactic essential for the organizations and assist for supply chain integration. Recently a big challenge for business leaders lies in the capability to suitably manage raw materials in adding value to product and services for achieving an efficient delivery to the end consumer and at the same time maintain the competitive advantage. Hence an efficient supply chain management is desired to handle exchanging material flow and information flow amongst the sharing entities which contributes to numerous incentives. The typical method of information exchange between Manufacturer and Customer impacting on the supply chain performance due to lack of transparency in information exchange causing miscommunication, duplication and various nonvalue added services involved in the process. Digitization between Manufacturer and Customer can eliminate these flaws which results in improved supply chain performance.

articleTitle: Recognition of Parkinson’s Disease Using Different Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Parkinson’s dise ase (PD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder affecting a significant number of individuals, with a prevalence rate of 1-2 per 1,000 people over the age of 60 and an overall prevalence of 1 percent. The disease manifests through involuntary movements, including tremors, rigidity, and difficulties with balance. This research focuses on identifying early signs of Parkinson’s disease, such as rapid eye motion and loss of smell, by analyzing cerebrospinal fluid data and dopaminergic imaging indicators. These indicators can be instrumental in the early detection of the disease. Furthermore, this study explores the implementation of machine learning algorithms for accurate diagnosis techniques, emphasizing the identification of the most effective algorithm for this purpose. By leveraging these advancements, early detection and diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease can significantly improve patient outcomes and facilitate timely intervention.

articleTitle: Random Forest Regressor Model for Rainfall Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Rainfall is cause of natural calamities like flood. Rainfall prediction is a major problem everywhere. Rainfall is a factor that affects several activities like agriculture, production, construction, generation of power, and tourism. Machine Learning is very useful nowadays to predict rainfall which is basically needed for today. In the current scenario, accurate rainfall prediction is a difficult task. Rainfall Prediction is an attempt to predict the rainfall for a region. Different algorithms for predicting rainfall is applied in this paper which includes classifiers well as a Regressor like Random Forest Regressor, Random Forest Classifier, Linear Regression, Support vector regressor (SVR), and Decision Tree Algorithm. Effective rainfall plays a huge role in the growth rate of crops in agriculture during crop growth. Applying Machine learning will calculate the amount of predictable rainfall which will be used for water resources, crop productivity and pre-planning of water usage. The proposed machine learning (ML) based approach will help to predict the amount of rainfall every year, with the help of a machine learning algorithm, the comparison of different algorithm results is also given in the paper. It is evident from the application of a different algorithm that the Random forest regressor outperforms over other algorithms with an accuracy score of 89%.

articleTitle: Insight Importance of Supply Chain Management of Vaccines in India During Covid Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In any industry whether it is a small-scale industry like a small bakery or any large production firm, supply chain always plays a pivotal role for effective distribution of a final product to a customer. Supply chain management is management of how you get your raw materials, in what quantity, quality of raw material, how you transform those raw materials to finished products (through various processes, different manufacturing techniques), and then finally distributing the finished product to a customer (through Logistics) in a proper time limit at a proper place. Supply chain management includes 5 main characters, i.e., supplier (of a raw material), producer (one who converts raw material to a finished product), distributor, retailer, and customer. Effectiveness and efficiency of any supply chain can be measured by various key performance indicators (KPI) like overall cost, cycle time, lead time, takt time, quality of a product, and many other variables. At the end main aim of any supply chain management is to provide the right product for the right customer at the right time and at a lower cost. Organization aims at improving the overall cost involved in the supply chain and reducing the middleman costs at each level.

articleTitle: Controlling the Antenna Signal Fluctuations by Combining the RF-Peak Detector and Real Impedance Mismatch
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The operational conditions of mobile phones are subject to constant fluctuations collected to varying touching situation and the presence of nearby objects. The impedance of the antenna exhibits changes as a consequence.The simultaneous occurrence of a change in link degree and a higher standing wave ratio necessitates using strapping power amplifier implementations, consequently resulting in reduced efficiency. This paper introduces a novel automated antenna tuner system designed for handheld applications. The system incorporates 2 series reactance and three straightforward ratio frequency RF-peak detectors to effectively detect and address reactive and fundamental impedance mismatches. The control loop necessitates the utilization of low-frequency electronics, resulting in its cost-effectiveness, energy efficiency, and relatively straightforward integration. The measurements conducted on the demonstrator system indicate that the observed behaviour of the Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) remains within acceptable parameters up to a value of 15.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Diagnosis in Radiology Images Using Transfer Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Diseases like cancer which are life-threatening needs accurate diagnosing techniques at a very early stage. This research work is focused on identifying one such technique for identifying breast cancers at a very early stage. This work focuses on employing radiology images of breast mammograms using a transfer learning technique, which is a very powerful deep learning technique that has proven to produce excellent results on computer vision projects. As medical data are very sparse and difficult to obtain transfer learning technique is employed where the knowledge gained through a previous task could be transferred to a new task of a different domain. Breast mammogram images were taken from the publicly available Mini DDSM Dataset which consists of breast mammogram images in the Medio Lateral Oblique (MLO) and bilateral Cranio Caudal (CC) views of both thebreasts. Three experiments were performed on the dataset to demonstrate the effectiveness of the technique by choosing three pre-trained models VGG19, ResNet 50, and Xception and the results were compared. The overall performance of the pre-trained models was found to be elevated due to the deployment of a Logistic Regression (LR) classifier. VGG19 pre-trained model proved to produce the topmost result of 88% accuracy on both the training as well as on the validation datasets. The other two pretrained models exhibited a slightly lower performance of ResNet50 with 80% and Xception with 79% accuracy.

articleTitle: Impact of Transceiver on the Multipath Indoor VLC Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In the present paper, the impact of transceiver configuration has been analyzed for the positioning error in indoor visible light communication system using the received signal strength (RSS) technique. The analysis has been done with four Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) through Line-of-Sight (LoS) as well as LoS plus first reflection (L-R1) signals. Three different cases have been considered with adjacent separation between each LEDs as 2.5m, 2.00m and 1.5m. The result shows that when the separation between adjacent LEDs is decreased then average received signal strength of LoS as well as L-R1 signals increase but it also causes average positioning error to increase.

articleTitle: Intelligent Face Recognition System to Enhance Security in Residential Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Rising price of security measures has been a significant concern recently. The study suggests creating a real-time facial recognition system to process images quickly to reduce monitoring costs and ensure that homes and businesses are secure. The primary objective of this research was to develop a deep learning-based facial recognition method for use in smart homes. This study aims to improve existing face recognition structures by using a hybrid of the SVM Increased and a convolutional neural network (CNN). The usefulness of the planned model is shown by comparing it to other state-of-the-art methods. The study presents a tree-based deep neural network for cloud-based face recognition that uses less data storage space without sacrificing accuracy. Multiple volumes are generated from the model’s input volume, and trees are then constructed for each volume, considering their height and branching structure. Each split is represented by a layer of convolution and two non-linear functions forming a residual function together. Evaluate the proposed model on many open-source datasets and compare it to state-of-the-art deep models for face recognition.

articleTitle: Enhanced Speech Based Human Emotion Identification by Hybrid Deep Learning and Optimal Features with Meta-Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Speech Emotion Identification (SEI) is a difficult job in emotional computing that faces challenges with conventional acoustic methods. To address this, a Hybrid Deep Learning (HDL) model is proposed in this research. SEI datasets are collected and pre-examined by artifact removal and filtering techniques. The extracted features include, Tonal Power(TP), spectral flux(SF), Mel Scale Spectrogram(MSS) and Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficient(MFCC). Optimal feature selection is performed using the Adaptive Search based Deer Hunting (AS-DH) algorithm to improve learning performance. The HDL model combines Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Deep Neural Networks (DNN) enhanced by AS-DH, achieving high accuracy in classifying affections like happy, sad, fear, calm and anger. The proposed AS-DH-HDL method outperforms various existing HDL methods with improvement in accuracy at a learning rate of 85. The performance evaluation demonstrates the superior performance of the developed model across various metrics.

articleTitle: Deployment Of Machine Learning Model to Evaluate the Quality of Green Spacing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Green space is any vegetated infrastructure. Green space promotes mental and physical wellness, socialization, and environmental protection. The state of green space determines its quality. Based on machine learning research, trash, lack of upkeep, and dirtiness lower green space quality. These algorithms evaluate green areas without considering human perception. Domain-based approaches are laborious, tedious and difficult to implement across large areas. This study suggests applying transfer learning on pre-trained models to design, analyze, and implement a machine-learning technique for human-perception green space quality assessment. Precision, F1-score, accuracy, recollection, Cohen’s Kappa, and Regular ROC-AUC were high for the generated models. In addition, the models’ file sizes and inference times were analyzed to guarantee their use in real-world settings. Grad-CAM, which uses heat maps to assess a model’s learning performance, was also included in the study. ResNet50 was the top-performing model, with 99.99 per cent accuracy, 99.99 per cent precision, 99.99 per cent recall, 99.00 per cent F1-score,0.98 Cohen’s Kappa, and an Average ROC-AUC of 1.00. The ResNet50 model was the second-fastest predictor and had a reasonable file size. Grad-CAM imaginings reveal that ResNet50 can accurately pinpoint regions crucial to its learning. Finally, an interactive online application based on the ResNet50 model was released via the Stream lit cloud platform.

articleTitle: Swarm Intelligent Data Clustering Performance Improvement by Social Spiders’ Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Researchers have focused on the collective intelligence of animals, birds, and insects over the last decade. Swarm intelligence is an artificial intelligence field that implements intelligent systems by studying the joint behaviour of social bugs and other animal cultures. Meta-heuristic procedures using swarm behaviour and complicated interactions without supervision have been used to address challenging optimization issues. Data cluster puts related data into groups. In addition, it may create discontinuous clusters. The term “disjoint” refers to a condition in which two or more elements or sets the crucial metrics in data clustering are accuracy and efficiency. Recent research has elucidated the characteristics of bio-inspired systems, highlighting their capacity as information-processing systems with specific cognitive capabilities. Nevertheless, widely used bio-inspired algorithms for data clustering still need to adequately consider the crucial trade-off between exploration and exploitation to achieve more optimal clustering outcomes. This article presents a bio-inspired procedure called social spider optimization (SSO) for gathering. The program aims to achieve a desirable equilibrium between exploration and exploitation by leveraging the distinct roles of female and male spiders. In this study, we conduct a proportional scrutiny of the outcomes found by the proposed procedure SSO about those achieved by K means, as well as other nature-inspired algorithms like colony optimization (IBCO) particle swarm optimization (PSO), ant colony optimization (ACO). The robustness of the method is seen to provide improved clustering outcomes. While Single-Source Optimization (SSO) effectively addresses the issue of being trapped in a local optimum, it necessitates adaptation to effectively identify the optimal solution within the vicinity of the created global solution. Therefore, SSO with K-means is used, yielding favorable outcomes in localized search operations. Our findings indicate that the suggested hybrid algorithms consistently outperform the alternative approaches regarding gathering outcomes. The presentation and efficiency of the suggested clustering approaches are measured and validated using the (SICD), regular cosine resemblance, precision, and inter-cluster reserve.

articleTitle: Multi-authentication system with face and finger print detection using image processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Detecting faces and fingerprints within images serves as a pivotal component in multiple computer vision applications. These applications encompass but are not limited to face recognition, facial expression analysis, and biometric systems designed for fingerprint identification. Owing to the considerable variation within the same class of images due to environmental influences on facial characteristics, the automated detection of faces and fingerprints poses a challenging binary classification task. In our research, we introduce an approach that combines a cascade face detection method with fingerprint data. This method leverages various types of features and classifiers for step-by-step elimination of non-face elements in the authentication process. The candidate feature set is constructed using Haar cascade and Minutiae points features of various granularities. Experimental results show enhanced performance in comparison to cutting-edge techniques.

articleTitle: Experimental Examination of Wastewater Treatment Analysis using Tamarind Seed Powder as Natural Coagulants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This paper is concentrated on the application of natural coagulants, as Discharges from numerous sectors pose a hazard to the environment and their characteristics are different from place to place. This issue necessitates the development of resource-efficient and environmentally friendly solutions. Synthetic chemical coagulation has been used to handle effluents from a range of sectors, and it has proven to be a value and accurate option. Industrial polymers, on either hand, are an issue of frustration because of their semi nature, difficulty to decompose, and physical hazards associated with their remains. Industrial chemicals are more expensive, while active compounds are more value, ecofriendly, and lengthy. Organic coagulants, while their proven usefulness for treating waste water from industries and possess a unique set of restrictions that have need to be verified for wide range of uses. The present research examines the use of natural coagulants in the treatment of industrial effluents, as well as their comparative benefits and drawbacks when related to synthetic coagulant i.e alum. New research subjects have also been discovered that could lead to the widespread production of natural coagulants, providing an ecofriendly and long-term solution to the issues caused by industrial pollutants and chemically based coagulants.

articleTitle: Block chain-Based on Real Estate market
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Global investments in real estate (RE) surpass those in the stock market by more than double. Despite this, there are far less investors in real estate due to its global accessibility and liquidity. Owners, investors, and tenants are hardly happy with the current setup. The purpose of this paper is to demonstrate the benefits that block chain. Technology can offer the real estate industry while also testing its application in this space. To date, investigations have yielded the following findings: Conclusively, block chain technology and smart contracts offer solutions to the conventional challenges encountered by renewable energy, proving to be significantly more advantageous. They serve as effective tools for establishing a game-theoretic, stable-priced market.

articleTitle: Implementation of Image Generative models using ImageGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Motivated by advancements in unsupervised representation learning for natural language, this paper sought to investigate whether comparable models could also generate useful representations for images. Using a sequence Transformer, we trained the model to autonomously predict pixels. GPT-2 scale model achieved impressive results, displaying robust image representations. To achieve the desired outcome, we implemented a two-stage approach, involving pre-training and fine-tuning. During the pre-training stage, we experimented with both autoregressive and GPT objectives. Based on findings, it appears that generative image modeling remains a promising avenue for acquiring high-quality, unsupervised image representations. This study will come in useful whenever there is a need for image completion. Given any random half image, the model will try to predict completed version of the image in multiple forms, which can be extended later to facial recognition, object identification as well as it might find its use in healthcare domain.

articleTitle: AIML: The Approach of Optimization to Support the Company Organizing the Automated Business Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Companies struggle with the ongoing optimization of their business processes. In this era of rapid technological advancement, ever-changing internal and external framework circumstances, and evolving consumer preferences, Businesses should optimize their internal procedures to provide the quickest turnaround times, the highest product quality, and other benefits. The goal of this article is to use techniques like machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) to examine how the digital revolution will affect Business Process Management (BPM). As a result, break down the essentials to show that everything fits together. Digital businesses will be interviewed and analysed to determine potential use cases. The paper's findings will consist of recommendations for future research and development in the area of business process management (BPM) and procedure optimization using machine learning and AI. The optimum tool for automated BPM may be determined with the use of machine learning and AI-based process of management strategies.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction Using Python Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Diabetes is a disease that can originate in a person if their blood glucose levels are continually higher. Diabetes should not be neglected since, if left untreated, it can lead to complications with the heart, kidneys, blood pressure, and other systems in the body. Diabetes can be managed, however, if it is detected at an earlier stage. In order to achieve this goal, the work we are doing on this project will assist in the early prediction of diabetes in the body of a human being. The application of machine learning algorithms yields superior results when predicting whether or not a person will develop diabetes based on previous datasets compiled using the patient’s medical history. To predict diabetes, this model will employ Machine Learning Classifier and ensemble approaches on a dataset. In this model, we will test the accuracy of several different machine learning algorithms, evaluate the accuracy of each method, and then select the algorithm that provides the best fit while having the highest accuracy among the available algorithms. Many machine learning algorithms exist, such as the Support Vector Machine, the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and the Random Forest Classifier (SVM).Nonetheless, we are utilizing the Random Forest Classifier since, compared to several other methods, it provides higher accuracy. This is because it is composed of several different decision trees. In addition, it makes use of randomization to improve its accuracy, prevent overfitting, and deliver a higher level of precision. We will use this Random Forest Classifier on the Pima dataset, and then, based on this earlier data, we will predict whether or not the individual has diabetes. The differentiation of system to other existing models, this project demonstrates a higher degree of accuracy. Also, we are integrating our model into the front end, which is simple to operate.

articleTitle: Classification using Deep CNN Feature Extraction and Hyper parameter Tuned Random Forest in Piperaceae plant Type
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Piperaceae otherwise known as the piper family, are a flowering plant family in large amount. This piperacease family contains around 3,600 species are presently accepted in 5 genera. The huge amount of special in this piperaceae family is two major genera: Piper (2,171 species) and (over 1,000 species) Peperomia. Piperaceae plant family may include tiny trees, climbers plants, or herbs. The allocation of this group of plants is top distributed in tropical regions of the earths. The species best-known by everyone is Black Pepper (Piper nigrum), most peppercorns yields that are mainly used as cooking spices, including piper betle, even though its connections in the family include numerous other spices. Piper nigrum is cultured for its fruit, which is typically dried and other as a spice and flavouring every food. The fruit is a (stone fruit) drupe which is about (0.20 in) 5 mm in diameter (fully and fresh mature), which encloses a single piper seed, dark red, and contains a stone like structure. The (Piper betle) or betel is a trailing plant of the Piperaceae family, which includes kava and pepper. The betel plant is indigenous to Southeast Asia. It is an dioecious perennial, evergreen plant, with shiny white catkins and heart like shaped leaves. Betel plants are cultured for their leaves which are the majority used in chewing areca nut for flavouring.

articleTitle: Implementation of GPT models for Text Generation in Healthcare Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The paper highlights potential of using generalized language models to extract structured texts from natural language descriptions of workflows in various industries like healthcare domain. Despite the criticality of these workflows to the business, they are often not fully automated or formally specified. Instead, employees may rely on natural language documents to describe the procedures. Text generation methods offer a way to extract structured plans from these natural language documents, which can then be used by an automated system. This paper explores the effectiveness of using generalized language models, such as GPT-2, to perform text generation directly from these texts. These models have already shown success in multiple text generation tasks, and the paper’s initial results suggest that they could also be effective in text generation in healthcare domain. In fact, the paper demonstrates that GPT-2 can generate comparable results to many current text generation methods. This suggests that generalized language models can increase the efficiency and accuracy in text generation, where workflows are repetitive and sequential.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification Models for Early Analysis and Prediction of Cervical Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Cervical cancer ranks among the prevalent gynecological malignancies, with an annual global incidence of roughly 500,000 new cases and approximately 300,000 fatalities. Early detection of cervical cancer is crucial for improving patient outcomes, and Machine Learning (ML) has emerged as a promising tool for accurate and efficient detection. In this project, we focus on using ML for cervical cancer detection, leveraging the classification, regression, clustering, and survival analysis capabilities of Google Colab. Through our use of various modelling techniques, we aim to develop an effective ML model for cervical cancer detection that can help save lives. Overall, this project demonstrates the potential benefits of using ML in gynecological cancer detection, particularly in the context of cervical cancer.

articleTitle: A Various CAD systems using mammogram for diagnosing breast cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: According to the report by Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) among women, total number of cancer cases is 7,12,758 in 2020 and may reach 8,06,218 in 2025. Breast Cancer is the mostly occur in women is expected to be 2,38,908 cases in 2025 which is 30% of total cancer causes. Detection of breast cancer at the initial stage is a main role in dropping the cancer cases. Developing a Computer Aided Diagnosis (CAD) system helps the radiologist to diagnosis the cancer at the initial stage. In this study review of recent CAD advancements, overview of steps used, methods used in each step is done. The study reveals that even though CAD system is promising but the current performance level could be improved. The performance level can be increased by improving the existing methods or finding new methods, so that CAD can be used as standalone system for detection and diagnosing breast cancer at clinics.

articleTitle: Attention Based CNN to Improve Identification of Ischaemia and Infection in DFU
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs) frequently occur as complications of diabetes. Identifying infection and ischaemia in DFUs is crucial for wound assessment and treatment planning. Recent advancements in deep learning have shown promise in classifying infection and ischaemia in DFUs using computerized methods. Many modern systems for classifying DFU images rely on deep neural networks, particularly convolutional neural networks. These networks analyze distinctive features and predict class probabilities based on these features. During testing, predictions are made using individual input images and trained parameters. To harness the information in training data more effectively, this study introduces the concept of an attention layer. This layer aids neural networks in memorizing long sequences of data, mitigates issues like exploding gradients, and enhances model accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that this proposed approach significantly improves the accuracy of DFU infection and ischaemia detection.

articleTitle: Motion-Classification using CNN and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Action recognition is an active research field in computer vision that has gained significant attention due to its practical applications. While deep learning approaches have shown promise, many existing methods fail to effectively capture spatiotemporal features from videos, mainly because they do not adequately consider the diversity of temporal scales. In this paper, we propose a novel approach, termed Long-Short-Term Spatiotemporal Features CNN (LSF CNN), to address this limitation. The LSF CNN consists of two subnetworks: the Long-Term Spatiotemporal Features Extraction Network (LT-Net) and the Short-Term Spatiotemporal Features Extraction Network (ST-Net). The LT-Net extracts long-term spatiotemporal features from stacked RGB images, while the ST-Net utilizes optical flow computed from adjacent frames to extract short-term spatiotemporal features. Additionally, we introduce a novel expression for the optical flow field, which has been empirically shown to outperform traditional methods in action recognition tasks. The spatiotemporal features from both scales are combined in a fully-connected layer and fed into a linear Support Vector Machine (SVM) for classification. By leveraging the two-stream architecture and the improved optical flow expression, our proposed approach enables comprehensive learning of deep features in both spatial and temporal domains. Extensive experiments conducted on the HMDB51 and UCF101 datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach, as it significantly improves action recognition accuracy by effectively incorporating long-short-term spatiotemporal information. This research contributes to advancing the state-of-the-art in human action recognition, opening up new possibilities for enhanced performance in various real-world applications.

articleTitle: ORPN Algorithm used to diagnosis and identify plant diseases based on image segmentation using deep learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Digital With a growing global population comes a correspondingly higher need for food, making plant disease modernization in agricultural areas a top priority for all nations. Improving productivity is crucial to India’s economy. Consequently, the detection of disease in greeneries plays a key role in the development sector. The accuracy and precision of diagnosing diseases in plants and animals have also been enhanced by the increased use of expertise in modern times. One solution to the problem of classifying different populations is the prospect of grouping in AI techniques. We aim to provide insight into the present state of the illnesses and how to detect them rapidly using computational reasoning. The article suggests thinking about how to use AI techniques to automatically detect plant diseases. This research paper uses the O-RPN (Optimized District Proposition Network) to isolate and control the leaves in a complicated ecosystem. The O-RPN computation incorporates the signs component using Chan-Vese (CV) techniques. The district-based CV calculation yields encouraging results for noise- and weak-edge-free image segmentation. In addition, we compare CNN and SVM using a unique dataset related to plant illnesses.

articleTitle: Using Naive Bayes Algorithm in the Internet of Things secure Drone-Cyber
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Recent developments in drone technologies enable new options and uses, particularly in miniature drones, which may be used in a wide range of settings. But these innovations also introduce new safety, flexibility, and uniformity difficulties. The commercial and military sectors may both benefit from small drones. There are problems with the design of the tiny drones and the way that security and safety are defined for them. Drone technology may now be used in previously unimaginable contexts, but the proliferation of IoT also introduces new risks. The data security and privacy risks the tiny flying intelligent gadgets pose are significant. Small drone design has yet to reach a point of maturity where it can meet the sector’s demands. Data conversions, privacy safeguards, and security measures are all necessary additions to the fundamental design problems. Security and flexibility issues with these modern drones may be mitigated by learning more about infiltration and interception in the Internet of Drones (IoD) space. In this study, presents the development of an Internet of Things-enabled drone using a machine-learning technique. An intelligent cyber security system may identify malicious Blockchain transactions using this strategy.

articleTitle: The Virtual Air Canvas Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: One of the most interesting and challenging research focuses on pattern recognition and image processing has emerged in recent days is writing in the air. In many different applications, it can improve the interface between a machine and a human and offers a substantial contribution to the development of automated operations. In the field of computer vision, object tracking is considered a key challenge. The method of analyzing a video usually consists of three primary steps: recognizing the object, tracking its movement from frame to frame, and finally evaluating its behavior. Choosing an adequate object representation, selecting tracking features, identifying objects, and tracking them are the four problems taken into consideration for object tracking. Object tracking algorithms are widely used in many real-world applications, including autonomous surveillance, video indexing, and vehicle navigation. This work exploits this gap by developing a motion-to-text converter that may be used as software for wearable intelligent devices that allow writing in the air. The proposed work acts as a recorder of rare gestures. Computer vision will be utilized to track the finger’s path. With the generated text, messages, emails, and other kinds of correspondence can all be sent. It will enable effective communication for the deaf. Keywords— object, emoji’s, image color, camera

articleTitle: Apple Diseases Detection: Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Apple’s quality and output often go down because of diseases, which affects the growth of the agricultural economy. Proper diagnosis and decision-making of apple diseases are crucial for reducing agricultural losses and boosting economic development. Using a unique Multi-scale Dense classification network, this article diagnoses 11 photos, including healthy and damaged apple fruits and leaves. Several illnesses were diagnosed. First, using typical image augmentation approaches, the Cycle-GAN algorithm was used to expand anthracnose and ring rot datasets. Cycle-GAN can simulate blemishes like anthracnose and ring rot on otherwise perfect apples using what it’s learned about healthy and sick apple images. When Cycle-GAN-generated photos of infected apples were introduced to the training set, the diagnostic accuracy increased compared to baseline approaches the user’s text was too short to be rewritten academically. Two models were created using Dense Net and Multi-scale connection techniques to facilitate the reprocessing of image characteristics from lower layers in organization neural networks. The research paper discusses the use of Multi-scale Dense Inception-V3 and Multi-scale Dense Inception-Resnet-V2 models. Both algorithms were able to identify 11 distinct picture kinds correctly. The overall accuracy and classification accuracy were higher than the DenseNet-121 network, representing a state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Enriched Resourceful Weighted Round Robin For Optimal Balancing of Loads in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Load balancing is considered as one of the most critical task of cloud computing as it requires an effective load balancing system to balance the network loads based on parameters including latency, throughput, execution time, response time, quality of services, fault tolerance, load balance, scalability, and resource utilization. In this paper, we develop a load-balancing model using an Enriched Resourceful Weighted Round Robin approach that aims at balancing the cloud based on several input parameters. The parameters including Response time, Processing cost and Resource Utilization helps in finding the intensity of loads in cloud environment. These inputs define the dynamic nature of load balancing in clouds and the round robin approach estimates the load and allocates the resources based on this. The simulation is conducted on CloudSim tool to test the efficacy of the model and the results of simulation show proposed model achieves higher rate of resource utilization with minimum overhead, reduced migration time and increased throughput that shows improved network performance than existing methods.

articleTitle: Smart tourism: Bibliometric analysis using Dimensions database
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The usage of technology has been increasing continuously among the tourists. The application of technology is denoted as ‘Smart Tourism’. This study intended to find out the publication trends in this field. Dimensions database was used to extract the bibliographic data using keywords “Smart tourism” and was analysed using VOSviewer. A total of 671 articles were studied. Four thematic clusters were identified using keyword analysis. These clusters linked the research with the use of big data, artificial intelligence, smart city, customer satisfaction. The analysis also depicted a steep growth in publications since 2018. “Sustainability” is found to be the most contributing journal, Chul-Mo Koo most contributing author. Based on the keyword analysis future studies may be carried out in the field of smart tourism city, smart tourism destinations, big data, smart tourism technologies etc. may be carried out.

articleTitle: An Insight on the Benefits of Diverse and Inclusive Workplace at it Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Many researchers have stated the significance of diversity and inclusion for effectiveness of organization. Though, challenges are remain in workplaces. Many organizations are trying to understand the real concept of diversity and inclusion in order to enjoy fruitful result of diversity and inclusion in their organization. The present study was indented to explore the challenges of diversity and benefits of inclusion in the work place. This study was analyzed diversity based on demographical variable among employees to find solution through the concept of inclusion. To do this, Informational Technology (IT) companies were chosen to collect the data. The structured questionnaire were prepared and distributed among 500 IT employees. The sample size 384 has been finalized by using the sample size table. It is valued at 95% confidence level and 0.05 margin of error. By applying ANOVA and Regression analysis, the data has been analyzed. From the study it found that Diversity in work place creates lots of challenges. By applying the concept of Inclusion the drawback and challenges was overcome. And from the regression analysis it found that Inclusion have an impact over Diversity. This study is a bridge between the employees in IT industry and this also helps top management to focus on the challenges of Diversity and give much more attention to the concept of Inclusion

articleTitle: Exploring a Novel Architecture for Wireless Sensor Network Protocol Stack and Analyzing Interconnected Data Flows
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The primary challenge faced by distant sensor networks lies in their energy sustainability, as individual device hubs grapple with limited resources and inadequate energy efficiency. This paper undertakes an examination of the information flow within the WSNs Convention stack and puts forth a modified version of the stack. In comparison to the current WSNs Convention stack, this adapted version aims to achieve reductions in energy consumption, overall communication delay, and system failures. To cater effectively to the distinctive requirements of WSNs, the proposed protocol stack incorporates a resource sharing controller, tasked with optimizing resource allocation across all stack levels. This approach seeks to curtail packet loss during communication while upholding flow control. Through the strategic alignment of each layer’s functions with the available resources, this methodology effectively mitigates energy usage concerns.

articleTitle: MIMO Optimized Algorithm to Develop the Energy Efficiency Underwater
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) are hampered by energy. The cooperative multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) technique saves strength. However, energy-efficient system design Cooperative multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) approaches don't account for the undersea environment's unique features, such as node dispersal. This research examines underwater magnetic induction (MI)-assisted therapeutic cooperation approaches. MIMO, WSNs may improve throughput, SNR, and connection. Cooperative MIMO and data aggregation were used to investigate. A framework improves network energy efficiency. To analyze data transmission energy use, a mathematical model will be constructed. Considering node data correlation. This work provides a combined MIMO system size optimization technique. This method views awaited transmittal distance. Transmission power limits must be included in the study. A competitive and cooperative MIMO creation method. Master node (MN) choice and concerted MIMO size optimization may boost the zip ratio. Simulations show that the suggested system saves energy and extends use. The network lasts longer.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Edge-Fog-Cloud Based Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Smart agriculture is a new concept that uses the latest technologies in the field of agriculture to improve quality and production. The development of the Internet of Things (IoT) has also brought a new dimension to the field of smart agriculture. The various technologies that are currently being used in the development of smart agriculture systems, such as the IoT, artificial intelligence, and cloud computing, are expected to greatly improve the efficiency and quality of the system. These innovations can help the agricultural industry reduce costs and improve production. However, it is seen that cloud systems are suited for huge data sets and its subset namely fog and edge could be used in the case of the smaller dataset. Further, due to the high cost of energy consumption, the implementation of the cloud layer creates a huge strain on the communication and information infrastructure of the system. In such cases, the fog and edge computing paradigm serve the purpose. Several studies have been conducted on the development of Edge-Fog-Cloud computing architecture, but none of them focused on the design of a system that can reduce its energy consumption. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to the design and implementation of an Edge-Fog-Cloud-based smart agriculture system that can reduce energy consumption and thereby the network traffic. The proposed approach can be used to run applications based on its resource requirements and the data which are collected with the help of the sensors in the agricultural field using the appropriate technology. In addition to reducing the system’s energy consumption, this method can also help optimize the network traffic.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for the Prediction of Diabetic Retinopathy in Type 2 Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy(DR) is an ophthalmic ailment that is generally found in Type 2 Diabetic patients. This disease causes notable effect on the retina of the human eyes. The classification of neural network models and diagnosis of DR at an early stage can avert the progression of disease. The neural networks models need to be trained for the classification as well as detection task. However, a deep neural network requires a significant volume of training data and sufficient time to accomplish the training of the model. Therefore, in this research work a hybrid model has been proposed for the prediction of diabetic retinopathy to resolve aforementioned issues, while retaining high accuracy. In the initial stage, standard datasets for diabetic retinopathy and blindness are obtained. Then, DenseNet201, ResNet101V2, InceptionResNetV2, EfficientNetB7, and Xception CNNs are chosen as the base models. The proposed hybrid model structure (DenseNet201 + ResNet101V2) is trained using the output obtained from the base model. In the final stage, the results of the hybrid model are compared with existing base models. The performance of proposed hybrid model is evaluated on the basis of various quality measures, such as accuracy, F1 score, recall, precision, loss, RMSE values, and loss. According to the experimental results, the proposed hybrid model (DenseNet201+ResNet101V2) achieved 98.37% classification accuracy of on the training datasets whereas 93.25% on the validation datasets.

articleTitle: Blockchain And Machine Learning-Based Real-Time Analysis of Smart Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: System to emerge as a foundational idea in administrative and deliberative contexts. Recent high-powered technologies, including the sensor-based Internet of Things (IoT), can provide enough means to keep tabs on the production process. This study proposes a method for keeping tabs on factories by combining the IoT, Machine Learning (ML), and other knowledges. Sensors connected to the Internet of Things record data about the surrounding environment. Sensors provide vast amounts of unstructured data that are updated in real time. The data is processed further using a variety of significant data methods. Fault detection in the production system is supported by a hybrid prediction model that employs the Random Forest organization method to filter out anomalies in the sensor data. The suggested technology was tested at South Korean automobile assembly plants. This system employs a strategy for securing and improving data trust to prevent the replacement of genuine data with dummy data and system transactions. In the results area, we show how our system performs compared to others. Associated to other inputs, the hybrid estimate model produces satisfactory fault predictions. Improvements in decision-making and reduced production errors are anticipated outcomes of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Supply Chain Management, Quality Management, and CRM in Microsoft and Apple
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This analysis examines the intricate dynamics of supply chain management (SCH), quality control, and customer relationship management (CRM) within two tech giants, Microsoft and Apple. Through an in-depth investigation of their strategies, practices, and outcomes, this study uncovers the unique approaches each company employs in these critical areas. Both Microsoft and Apple, leaders in the technology industry, rely on efficient supply chain management to deliver innovative products and services. This research dissects their procurement, logistics, and distribution strategies, revealing how these practices impact their operational efficiency and competitiveness. Quality management is another focal point, encompassing product design, manufacturing, and post-market monitoring. The study illuminates the methods employed by both companies to ensure top-tier product quality and customer satisfaction.Furthermore, the analysis delves into their CRM strategies, illustrating how Microsoft and Apple engage with their customer base, gather feedback, and tailor offerings to evolving consumer needs. By exploring these key business dimensions, this study offers valuable insights into the operations of Microsoft and Apple, providing potential lessons for organizations seeking to optimize their supply chains, elevate product quality, and cultivate enduring customer relationships in the dynamic tech sector.

articleTitle: Assessment Of Predictive Analytics In Profits Prediction: A Commercial Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In fact, as big data continues to grow and spread, analytical systems become increasingly necessary for businesses. As a result, predictive analytics in general are used to find relationships and patterns in data so that better preventative decisions can be made in the future by analyzing the past. However, their intended use varies from industry to industry. This paper explains why predictive analytics are used in so many different industries and how they have been used to solve so many problems in different industries. The prescient examination have many advantages, for example, lessen and forestall risk, save time, cost and better administration of assets notwithstanding the capacity to take better essential choices in light of reality not on instinct. In addition, the research in the area reveals difficulties, such as the lack of accurate, sufficient, and clean data for testing developed models. In addition, it exemplifies the research area’s shortcomings, such as focusing solely on model development, selecting the wrong variables and algorithms for models, which have an impact on predictions’ final results, and what can be improved in subsequent studies.

articleTitle: Time Series Lag Models to Analyze Impact of Air Pollution on Daily Incidence of Schizophrenia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Exposure to pollutants like PM2.5, PM10, CO, Ozone, NO2, and SO2 has been linked with an increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia, as per a few studies. In this study, we use daily pollution data from the Central Pollution Control Board, India, and the number of admissions(NoA) of schizophrenia patients in hospitals in Bangalore City, India, for measuring the daily incidence of schizophrenia. Here, the number of admissions is derived based on entry-exit logs maintained in the hospitals. We examine the association between these two sets of temporal data and forecast the daily occurrence using pollutant data. We evaluate with a time series technique called Vector Auto Regression (VAR) and distributed lag non-linear model (DLNM) to analyze the lagged association of daily concentration of pollutants on Schizophrenia. We applied the VAR technique to analyze the various interrelationships and lagged impact between hospital logs of schizophrenia and air pollutants. In our statistical analysis, Poisson generalized linear regression in conjunction with the DLNM is utilized to explore the nonlinear and lagged effect. Our study found that the effect of all pollutant values in Bangalore city was statistically significant to schizophrenia admissions in city hospitals. These pollutants have a short-term lag effect of 0 to 5 days(95% CI). The forecasts of schizophrenia admissions from air pollutant models using DLNM outperformed VAR-based MSE and RMSE metrics.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Flexibility Evaluation Model: An Empirical Validation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
