articleTitle: Analyzing the Social Media Advertising with ML Model: WEKA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Social media (SM) might be helpful for advertisers, Marketing people, and customers. Leaders in the business who need to investigate customer preferences and spending patterns are doomed to fail. Data mining methods extract information about consumer wants and needs to forecast their purchasing behavior. This article aims to look at a new approach to social media marketing by analyzing data from social media platforms with the use of ML methods, more especially the Waikato Environment for Knowledge Analysis (WEKA). Compared to other relevant algorithms, WEKA performs better than its competitors, particularly when looking at metrics like accuracy, recall, and F-measure.

articleTitle: Compare ML Models to Improve Twitter Fake News Discovery and Verification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Recently, having a solid online profile is essential today. Compared to more conventional sources, Twitter is often regarded as the most reliable. It is one of the most popular platforms for sharing one’s thoughts and emotions. To identify fake stories, this paper presents a supervised machine-learning method. Finding new characteristics that are more indicative of enhancing performance classifiers is one of the credibility-finding difficulties. Fresh content-based quality and user-centric ones are both used. Examining the significance of characteristics and their subsequent impact on efficiency is shown. The rationale behind selecting the ultimate feature set utilizing the k-best method is elucidated. A total of seven directed machine learning algorithms are employed in this study. Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression, K-nearest neighbour, Random Forest, Naive Bayes Maximum Entropy, and Conditional Random Forest are some of the classification techniques being considered. An examination of the characteristics is presented, and they are assessed against content-specific traits to determine accuracy. Regarding reliability (82.2%), employing user-based features exclusively is where Casual Forest excels, followed by a sequence of content- and user-based elements. Using the casual forest classifier’s accuracy (83.4%), we found that combining both kinds of information yielded the best results. However, logistic regression performed well when it came to employing content-based variables. Precision accuracy, recall, and F1 score are metrics used to evaluate performance. Analyzed the effect of the new features by comparing them to those of previous research’s feature sets. When comparing the findings to the present results of how it is created, noticed that they show significant improvement concerning identifying and debunking fake news.

articleTitle: To study about various existing schemes in this field of cloud enabled cognitive radio environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Cognitive Radio-(CR) promises consistent communications performance thanks to its adaptive learning and reconfiguration capabilities. C4ISR systems require enormous amounts of data, which can be stored and processed in the cloud. Today’s wireless technologies, on the other side, have trouble quickly and reliably moving different types of data on battlefields. For cloud access, data communication with reliable and time is the assurance from CR networks. Connecting CRs inclusively with the cloud gets around each one’s performance problems. Cloud enabled cognitive radio is made effective with future internet for application provisioning.

articleTitle: Optimizing Pesticide Decisions with Deep Transfer Learning by Recognizing Crop Pest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The goal of this study is to design a user-friendly web application to help farmers to lead farming activities and maximize their profits by using deep transfer learning techniques for identifying pests. Insects are a huge problem in agricultural activity hindering production and causing tremendous loss of agricultural produce. The growth of pests leads to loss of production, therefore, dealing with these pests in a timely manner is of utmost importance. It is estimated that the insect pest on average causes 15–20 per cent losses of yield in food and cash crops. The proposed work aims to strengthen our farmers by helping them adopt technology to increase yield and productivity by using deep transfer learning models by identifying pests and then suggest pesticides that need to be used. Classifier for identifying pests contains hundreds of thousands of parameters, and building one from the beginning needs a large amount of labelled training data as well as powerful processing to attain accurate results. These constraints are largely overcome via transfer learning. This study employs deep transfer learning to identify pests and suggest the best pesticides using Residual Neural Network (ResNet50) and Visual Geometry Group Network (VGG16) which were trained using pre-trained ImageNet. ResNet50 and VGG16 are trained and it is observed that VGG16 outperforms with an accuracy of 99%. The pesticide recommendation model will suggest farmer, which pesticide to use based on an insect image uploaded by the farmer. Thus it assists users in implementing technology to produce crops effectively and, as a result, succeed in increasing yields at a reasonable price.

articleTitle: Computed Tomography Liver Tumor Image Classification Using Hybrid Feature Extraction and Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Accurate diagnosis of liver tumor is important task for the physician. The purpose of this research work is to investigate the utility of feature extraction and classification techniques in the diagnosis of liver tumor CT images as benign(non-cancerous) and malign(cancerous). The classification results can give useful information for the physician in diagnosing the tumor. In this work, the important features representing the tumor are extracted using SURF, LTP, and PCA. Then extracted features are passed to LSTM to identify the type of liver tumor. Experiments are carried out on the dataset collected from hospital. It is observed that the proposed method performs better when compared to the radiologist results.

articleTitle: Design of an Efficient Deep Learning Framework for Covid-19 Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The worldwide health crisis caused by COVID-19 and the subsequent control measures have had significant and widespread impacts on various aspects of human life. Detecting COVID-19 early is crucial for effective diagnosis, and ML algorithms have played a vital role in speeding up the process and improving efficiency. However, factors like delivery time and access to training data are also crucial considerations. Extensive analysis of lung ultrasound pictures using the COVID-19 database and deep learning algorithms show that the former is superior to the latter in terms of illness diagnosis. Without specialised testing, it might be difficult to tell COVID-19 from other viral fevers. The research suggests a method of COVID-19 image classification using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Further evidence of the superiority of the proposed model is provided by a loss and accuracy comparison study.

abstract: Historically, the severity of leaf symptoms was the most important diagnostic indicator for plant diseases. As the day progressed, the amount of plants to be cultivated grew, and so did the level of complexity. Due to diverted manure practises, modern illnesses are substantially different from historical diseases, making diagnosis difficult for even seasoned farmers and agronomists. Although there is no such thing as a "wrong" diagnosis or a "one-size-fits-all" therapy, there is nothing to lose by seeking treatment after a diagnosis has been made. Due to the extensive incidence of vascular fungal infections and the harm they bring to plants, this issue impacts a wide range of crops. Fusarium wilt is a fungus that may infect a broad range of plant species (FW).Thissoil-borne fungal disease affects tomatoes, sweet potatoes, tobacco plants, legumes, and cucurbit plants. The primary objective of this research is to facilitate the identification of FO disease intomato plant leaf. In addition to enhancing precision, the new strategy doubles the number of timessickness categorization and identification are conducted during model development. 60 percent of the 87k images in the public database depict leaves that have been damaged in some manner,whereas 40 percent depict leaves in excellent condition. articleTitle: Evaluating the Implementation of Adapting Soft Learning with Deep Reinforcement for Logistics and Supply Chain Enhancement in the Smart Electric Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The logistics and supply chain operations in the smart electric vehicle (EV) industry can be improved by applying advanced techniques such as deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and adapting soft learning. The study analyzes the benefits and challenges of using these above mentioned techniques. The paper also investigates the impact of these techniques on the efficiency, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness of the logistics and supply chain processes. The results suggest that the integration of deep reinforcement learning and adapting soft learning can lead to significant improvements in the logistics and supply chain operations, including enhanced delivery time, reduced costs, improved accuracy and most importantly improved customer satisfaction. However, the study also highlights the need for careful consideration of the implementation process and potential challenges, such as the availability and quality of data, and the need for skilled personnel to manage the systems. As a result this paper provides valuable insights into the application of advanced techniques in the logistics and supply chain operations of the smart electric vehicle industry.

articleTitle: Recommending You Tube Videos based on their Content Efficiently
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The sheer volume of data makes it challenging to locate pertinent information in today's age of abundant YouTube videos. A system of recommendations was developed to help users find information that would be most interesting to them to improve this process. Algorithms, computations, and implicit user input are the backbone of most recommendation systems. These techniques work well, except the video lacks implicit input, so the algorithms will likely fail to identify significant material. Cold-start occurs when a video is first posted and has no history or viewer comments attached to it. Every day, users also need help with the issue of discovery, which is hampered by the fact that films need labels or a large number of views to be easily discovered. Because the search engine’s method relies on the description tags and keywords you’ve assigned to the video footage rather than the video itself, in this research, we offer a content-based recommendation system that is capable of identifying in-video objects and noises and providing users with the option to search for relevant material using submitted scenes or filter results using keywords. Further experiments have been conducted using a wide range of situations to prove further the efficacy of the suggested system for video content suggestion.

articleTitle: A Smart Wearable Stockings-Based Therapy For Control Of Varicose Vein By Thermo-Vibrational Technique Using Ai
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The varicose vein are superficial veins that are abnormal, enlarged, and twisted caused by weakening the vessel valves within. This most common condition is found to be more than 10 million cases in India usually appearing in the legs and feet. Researchers’ records show that a mild varicose vein disease does not commonly need a doctor’s care, it can get liberation from distress with at-home handling and several alternative remedies. Recently surgery, and laser ablation techniques are adopted for help, butth is condition is incurable to relieve discomfort; the doctor may recommend elastic support stockings. The major intention of this research this project is to develop wearable stockings that treat the causes of varicose using thermo-vibrational therapy in a non-invasive manner. The Peltier crystal and mechanical vibrator belong to the the rapeutic side, which is activated by the motion-tracking sensors. The AI-controlled device provides aesthetic relief from the pain which doesn’t require anesthesia.

articleTitle: Modeling House Price Prediction Model using XG Boost and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Every year, the cost of homes rises, necessitating the development of a system that can forecast future home prices. The ability to estimate house prices can be useful to both the developer and the customer in planning the best time to buy a home. The physical state, design, and location of a house are the three variables that affect its cost. This paper discusses using Python modules to estimate housing prices using regression approaches. The proposed method utilized more precise house price calculations and provided more accurate predictions. It also discusses graphical and numerical methods for housing price prediction. This paper describes our machine learning-based house price model and its dataset. Real estate data mining is frequent. Data mining can anticipate house values, essential property features, and more by extracting meaningful information from raw data. Research shows that property price variations worry homeowners and the real estate market. To find the best house price prediction models, a literature review is done. This investigation showed that Artificial Neural Networks, Support Linear Regression, and were the most efficient models. We also found that locational and structural features predict property prices. This study will help housing developers and academics identify the most important factors affecting house prices and identify the best machine learning model for this subject. articleTitle: Deep Learning Classification and Segmentation of Brain MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Unique Clinical pictures have a basic impact on the specialist’s capability to the right conclusion and in the treatment of the patient. Diagnostic imaging can quickly identify lesions thanks to sophisticated algorithms, and it is essential to glean characteristics from photographs. In a number of studies, a number of algorithms have been incorporated into imaging in medicine. Using convolutional neural network, CNN’s fundamental architecture is constructed using picture component extraction. To be able to circumvent the limitations imposed by both machine vision and human vision, the study is extended to include CNN with multiple input channels for visual feature extraction. This study uses approximately 3300 MRI samples from Kaggle to investigate four classifications: tumors of the pituitary gland, meningioma, glioma, and none. The implemented BrainNet has a accuracy of 98.31 percent and a validation accuracy of 87.80 percent. In order to determine which strategy performed better, deep architectures like InceptionNet and ResNet were also put through tests with or without learning through transfer.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Cloud Performance using the Clustering Method of Scientific Workflow Task
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The scientific community may save money using cloud computing to roll out massive workflow apps. Scheduling workflow jobs with changing resources is a complex problem when running large-scale scientific applications for workflow in a distributed heterogeneous environment. In addition, a scheduling algorithm has to effectively use the resource’s time in a utility-based computing environment like the cloud, which allows for a pay-per-use model of the resources. The cloud is inherently dynamic, yet most scheduling methods ignore this and instead generate static schedules. A public cloud setting, such as Amazon EC2, has access to a plethora of resources and pays for them hourly. Any time used in fractions of an hour is rounded up to the nearest whole hour. The proposed work centres on integrating an accounting model cognizant task clustering technique into the workflow scheduling procedure to satisfy the customer’s budget and deadline. A method for selecting the most appropriate resources at any given point in a process is also presented. Two scientific programs, Montage and Cyber Shake, were run with varying resources and task clustering methods, and the first findings are described.

articleTitle: Detection of Animal Hunters in Forest Using Regional Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Detection of objects moving in a video is regarded as a vital problem in image processing applications i.e. the detection during the movement of camera is considered significant in video processing. In this paper, the movable objects for instance humans moving in forest environment is detected using a deep learning algorithm called regional convolutional neural network (RCNN). In this classification model, the classifier segregate the moving human in a dynamic environment. The region of motion is initially detected via background compensation method. The RCNN is utilised then to locate accurate the person moving in that region of motion. The RCNN model is a lightweight classifier that is designed specifically for the smaller objects. The results of both motion and object detection is fused together to obtain the moving objects. If a moving information is missed in the current frame, it is then recalled in the subsequent frame as per the spatial or temporal data. The simulation is conducted on 30 videos, where 24 is used for training the classifier and remaining 6 is taken for testing purposes. The result of simulation shows that the proposed RCNN model obtains improved accuracy, specificity, sensitivity and f-measure.

articleTitle: Predicting the Impacts of the Environment on the Probability and Severity of Electrical Injuries by AIML
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The acceleration of global warming and environmental degradation has been attributed to industrial growth and fossil fuel utilization. Consequently, this phenomenon has resulted in a rise in the frequency and intensity of natural disasters. Due to their predominantly outdoor installation, generators are subject to significant impacts. The occurrence of natural disasters has led to an increase in accidents associated with electrical equipment. This paper analyses statistical data on electrical fires, electric shock accidents, and electricity-related accidents caused by climate change in domestic settings to determine the associated risk rating.In this study, we propose a risk assessment model for electrical fires, explicitly focusing on every month. Our approach involves analysing data on electrical hazards in different regional areas, particularly metropolitan cities, considering climatic conditions such as temperature and humidity. Additionally, we aim to evaluate the accident risk rating associated with natural disasters, specifically those related to low and high-voltage equipment. In this study, a risk analysis model has been developed to assess electrical hazards in different regions and equipment types. The model presented herein serves as a foundational predictive tool. Hence, offering electrical security amenities in the forthcoming period is feasible by giving a risk estimation map delineating potential dangers specific to each geographical area and wiring category via web platforms or mobile applications utilizing the investigation data provided. Additionally, it is imperative to enhance the resilience and dependability of electrical components as a proactive measure against electrocute ions resulting from climate change-induced emergencies.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This paper aims to provide a straightforward calculation for locating and quantifying cerebrum cancer in MR images. Because they are found in the constrained space of the skull known as the intracranial pit, cancers of the brain come with an inherent risk. People who succumb to cerebrum growths frequently receive incorrect analyses, as is the case with the majority of tests performed in developed nations. Using CT results or X-beams guided into the intracranial pit, the frontal cortex has been imaged all around. The doctor discovers and evaluates a mind cancer during the visual evaluation of this image. However, this method of recognition limits the accuracy with which the cancer's stage and size can be determined [1]. By joining two calculations, this study uses PC-aided division (recognition) of cerebrum cancers to avoid the problem. Using this method, growth tissues can be divided with greater precision and reproducibility than by hand. Additionally, this tactic may shorten the exam duration. As a result, a cancer's growth stage is determined by the number of group regions and how distinct it is from the MR image or its area.

articleTitle: Insomnia Detection using Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The inability to fall asleep, stay asleep, or have non-restorative sleep is known as insomnia. This disorder can significantly lower an individual's quality of life in most poor nations. The study aimed to assess this methodology's efficacy and identify risk factors linked to sleep problems using machine learning techniques. By analyzing a large dataset and employing advanced algorithms, the researchers sought to uncover significant predictors of sleep disabilities and understand the performance of machine learning in this context. In this paper, analysis is done by random forest and LGBM classifiers. The dataset consist of 99,997 participants and their age is between 35-65 years. The comprehensive analysis is also performed and the dataset is fetched from Scopus database.

articleTitle: Development Of an Intelligent Traffic Navigation System by Wireless Sensor Network System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The use of automobiles is becoming more important worldwide, especially in densely populated cities. Current transportation infrastructure technologies include wired sensors, inductive loops, and satellite navigation. The installation and upkeep of surveillance equipment (cameras, etc.) are quite costly. In addition, environmental factors affect these instruments’ precision. Traditional methods typically aim to optimize traffic light management for a given traffic density and layout. One key draws back all these methods, however, it may be challenging to represent the dynamic behaviour of traffic volumes and configurations, which is always changing. Therefore, in an effort to solve the aforementioned problem, this study proposes methods for adaptive traffic light management via the use of a distributed sensor network. The purpose of this study is to examine approaches to developing a smart system that can integrate and support some of the current technologies of traffic management, therefore decreasing the typical wait time for cars at a junction. The suggested algorithms are flexible enough to adjust to the particulars of traffic at every given crossroads. (GLD) is a traffic simulation tool used to model real-world traffic conditions and provide graphs of average waiting time vs cycle counts. The collected findings validate the efficacy of the suggested strategy for traffic regulation at a real-world road junction.

articleTitle: Multi-Strategies inferred Convolution Neural Network for Land Cover Classification through Landsat 8 OLI Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Land Cover Classification of the hyperspectral images poses a significant importance to categorize the land classes and identifying changes using change detection techniques with respect to various seasons’ variations and climates variation. It leads to considerable challenges to current researchers as temporal variability of spectral, temporal and spatial characteristics of different reflectance bands of Landsat dataset. Land cover changes highly affects the current ecosystem, hence change information of land cover is significant for estimating the atmosphere. Computation of land cover changes in urban and rural region is highly complex due to its wide ranging degradation and high spatial and spectral changes. Further to enhance urban and rural land cover classification and mapping of the similar lands, a discriminative deep learning model entitled as Multiple Strategies inferred Convolution Neural Network for extraction of end member is been designed and experimented in this article. Initially, end members of the hyperspectral images are exploited on computation of pure spectral signatures along its fractional abundances map of pixel of the images. Extracted Endmember are projected to the principle component analysis technique to reduce the spectral feature as it impact the model with computational complexity. Principle component analysis is incorporated to generate reduced feature by retaining the most significant features. The reduced spectral and spatial features is transformed to deep learning model considered as multiple strategies inferred convolution neural network model. Convolution layer and max pooling layer is employed for feature processing and fully connected layer is employed to process for identification and mapping of the land cover along computing the change detection constraints and spectral indices (end members). Changes detection identification on the spectral indices classifies the land cover regions and computation of the spectral and spatial value with respect to N finder algorithm provides the pixel purity index. N finder technique considered as a change detection method. Experimental investigation of the proposed deep learning architecture is implemented using Landsat 8 OLI dataset and it performance is evaluated using generated spectral indices along the conventional approaches. Present architecture produces accuracy above 99% on comparing with conventional classification techniques.

articleTitle: Investigations on Novel and Effective HR practices in Employee Turnover in Multinational Companies

articleTitle: Automated Music Synthesis Using Recurrent Neural Network and Long Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Music generation is a new domain of research in its primitive stage. Music generation model in this project employed Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) cells to generate melodies in the MIDI format. The model was trained on ESAC dataset of symbolic music representation using a one-hot encoding scheme. The system was able to produce musically coherent melodies with some degree of variability by adjusting the temperature parameter in the sampling function. The project demonstrated the potential of using deep learning models for music generation tasks. In this project, training accuracy of 85% was obtained.

articleTitle: Content Based Image Retrieval System using Modified LSTM with Clustering and K-D Tree Indexing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: A Robust Content-Based Medical Image Retrieval System must be designed to support the ever-increasing volume of digital photographs across various medical disciplines in order to successfully return medical photos that are aesthetically comparable to the query image. The CBMIR approach for optimum medical image retrieval is presented in this research work, with a focus on reducing deviation in medical image mining and a full analysis of significant aspects of medical photos. The purpose of this research was to develop a LSTM based deep learning model for classifying CT Liver tumor images from the CT Liver tumor images dataset. The dataset is preprocessed with thresholding, extreme point computation, and bicubic interpolation. Second, the proposed method uses a convolutional neural network based LSTM to extract information from cropped photos. There are four measures used to evaluate the model’s efficacy: accuracy, precision, recall. Accuracy at 96.88%, precision at 97.96%, recall at 96.60% are all optimally achieved by the proposed model. According to the findings, the proposed LSTM based RNN Approach with KD Tree model is the most efficient method for identifying CT Liver Tumor images detection and classification.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Its Impact on Employment: A Perspective in Context of Keynesian Employment Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The present study explores the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on employment in the context of Keynesian theory of employment. The Keynesian theory suggests that employment is directly related to aggregate demand in the economy and that government intervention can help stabilize employment levels. The emergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to create disruption in the employment patterns that are traditional as the machines are rapidly becoming able to perform the tasks that are done by humans. This paper studies the potential impact of AI on both skilled and unskilled labor markets. The current study argues that while artificial intelligence can enhance the productivity and output, it may also expand the income inequality and lead to job displacement for certain segments of the workforce. The paper also discusses the role of government intervention in response to the potential effects of AI on employment. The paper argues that government policies, such as education and retraining programmes, are necessary to ascertain that the workforce is able to adapt to the changing dynamics of labour market. Therefore, the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on employment generation is both multi-dimensional and tangled and Keynesian theory provides a useful framework for understanding the impact of AI on employment as well as the role of government intervention in response.

articleTitle: Identification of Parkinson’s Disease Using Machine Learning Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Following Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s disease is a neurodegenerative disease that affects a majority of people in the world. This disease brings a great loss of both nerve cells and neurological capacity because the cells that generate dopamine are harmed. This paper is to inspect Parkinson’s disease using a speech feature dataset, recording features of both Parkinson-affected people and healthy individuals. The dataset is processed, and the required features are fed into different machine learning predictive models which are relatively new. The efficiency and accuracy of the same algorithms are recorded and compared to show which algorithm serves the best for early and accurate predictions.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Humans communicate most naturally and quickly through speech. Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) attempts to identify human emotions and affective states from speech. This capitalizes on voice tone and pitch, reflecting underlying emotion. The voice signal is a rich source of information and a powerful medium for communicating approach and eliciting emotions. Audio emotion recognition needs feature extraction and classifier training. The feature vector must contain audio signal elements that characterize speaker-specific properties, including tone, pitch, and energy, to train the classifier model to classify an emotion effectively. RAVDESS, an English language open source dataset of male and female acted speech corpus, is carefully trained and tested. We retrieved MFCC coefficients from training dataset audio samples to reflect speaker vocal tract information. Energy and MFCC coefficients of neutral, anger, fear, and sadness audio samples are measured. The classifier model receives extracted feature vectors. After extraction, the classifier will determine the test audio’s emotion. Features and classifiers are needed for audio-based emotion identification. Tone, pitch, and energy are speaker-specific audio signal components in the feature vector. Training the classifier model to recognize an emotion requires these components. The RAVDESS [1] open-source English language training and testing dataset was separated correctly. This dataset contained male and female acted speech corpus contributions. We retrieved MFCC coefficients from training dataset audio samples to represent the speaker’s vocal tract. We also extracted features from natural speech. We measured energy and MFCC coefficients of neutral, angry, fearful, and melancholy audio samples. The classifier model receives their extracted feature vectors. After extracting the dataset, the classifier will determine the emotion in the test audio.

articleTitle: Food Safety Control Using CNN Model in Image Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Adulteration is one of the major problems in food products. It makes the food products impure and alters their original form. Adding contaminants to the pure form of food is becoming a common practice to boost market growth. Some of the important food products that we consume daily such as fruits and vegetables have been adulterated with chemicals which cause harmful to health and cause various diseases. This research paper focuses on the overview of image processing techniques with CNN Models to detect adulteration from sample images of food products that we consume in our daily life. The images of food products such as cashew nuts, Rice grains, Corn seeds, green coffee beans, virgin olive oil are taken in some of the paper and various image processing techniques with convolution neural network algorithms are used to detect the adulterant mixed in the products from this the research paper gives an overall view of food adulteration with image processing and CNN models and its applications.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Automated Hydroponic System using Intelligence Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Agriculture plays a significant role in the economy of the country. articleTitle: Fake News Detection using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The spread of false news threatens news and information sources, especially in Indian politics. We present a machine learning-based strategy to identify false news by vectorizing and tokenizing news headlines using a pre-defined dataset of authentic and fraudulent news items. We want to create a model that can properly identify news stories by textual content, separating propaganda from real news. Our technique is tested on a benchmark dataset of news items. Our suggested technique outperforms various state-of-the-art false news detection algorithms in the literature. Our methodology can prevent false news and safeguard news and information sources in Indian politics. This technique is versatile and successful for identifying and reducing the impact of false news across several topics and languages.

articleTitle: LoRa network-based alert system for illegal sandalwood cutting and vandalism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Vandalism and unauthorized sandalwood harvesting are severe threats to the ecosystem and to forests. To solve this problem, we created and built a LoRa network-based alert system and then presented the testing results. We put the system to the test in a forest and evaluated how well it connected, how precisely it detected things, and how long the battery lasted. Our results show that the system is effective at detecting abrupt shaking and can reliably send data over long distances using the LoRa network. Forest officials can easily monitor the condition of the trees using the Blynk Cloud Mobile app and web dashboard. They may also take action in the event of any suspicious activity. Overall, the LoRa network-based alarm system holds the promise of reducing illegal sandalwood harvesting and vandalism while defending the ecosystem and forests.

articleTitle: Crowd Estimation Using Sensors for Public Transport (BUSES)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Population in Indian metropolitan metropolises have been growing at an intimidating rate. articleTitle: Development of a mobile application to control and monitor the electricity: IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Many severe societal issues, like the spread of loneliness and Alzheimer's disease, have their roots in the senior population's declining social connections. A human-centred system may be the key to resolving these issues and fostering peaceful cohabitation. Therefore, to create a robot system that uses smart devices—a prerequisite for IoT technology that enables services like information assistance and monitoring—by connecting them. Smart-device-centred robots and their linked peripheral devices will make the dream of a hyper connected society a reality as smart-device development and application continue to advance. People, objects, and information all share a standard network in today's hyper connected world. A substantial mobile robot will soon be able to board a human due to the convergence of personal mobility and robotic technologies. Wireless networks allow these robot technologies to deliver naturally linked services. the early stages of what will become a new paradigm in the evolution of human eccentric systems enabled by interplay between robot systems, smart devices, and mobility engineering in the age of Society 5.0. As a result, this research presents the concept of developing an IoT-based robot and mobility system centred on humans. Finally, demonstrate the usefulness of the proposed approach by providing many case studies.

articleTitle: Dense Convolution Neural Network for Complex land Cover Classification and change detection using Landsat OLI 8 hyperspectral Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Hyperspectral Image is employed to observe the earth surface with respect to spectral reflectance value on the electromagnetic spectral ranges of electromagnetic spectrum initiating on the visible regions to infrared region. It identifies the spectral feature space and classifies it with respect to minerals and land covers. Hyperspectral images have been proposed using existing unsupervised and supervised classifier towards classification. Multiple complications have been exploited on the hyperspectral images as it contains the Hughes phenomenon. In order to alleviate those problems, dense convolution neural network methodology is architected in this research. It capable of classifying the spectral images with reduced processing time. Initially pre-processing of the hyperspectral image is carried out to reduce the noise and improve the contrast of the hyperspectral images. preprocessed image is projected to linear discriminant analysis to extract the spectral end members and spatial endmembers of the image. Those extracted spectral and spatial endmembers is employed to Dense Connected Convolution Neural Network as it is highly capable in land cover classification and discrimination. Deep learning model containing the convolution layer and max pooling layer for feature map generation and fully connected layer is highly capable in generating the spectral indices to classify the land cover and detecting the land cover changes on the spatial features. Softmax layer employs the spectral index for classification and change detection. Cross entropy is employed to reduce the loss of the model. Further hyperparameter tuning is carried out using gradient decent to generate the high discriminant classes of the land cover. The experimental outcomes of the current model are verified on using hyperspectral image gathered from Landsat 8 OLI dataset. Performance of the current approach is evaluated with state of art approaches on measures like precision, recall and f measure on cross fold validation. On analysis of its outcomes, it is confirming that current architecture exhibiting increased performance in classification accuracy of 99.43% on compared with conventional approaches.

articleTitle: Evaluating Impact of Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture: A Statistical Validation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The cultivation area assumes a huge part in the monetary area. All over the world, the human brain is a major topic of discussion and concern. Additionally, as the population grows on a daily basis, so does the interest in food and business. The farmer's standard methods, which we used, were deficient to meet the necessities. As a result, artificial intelligence is added. As a result of this strategy, a lot of people received food and work opportunities. The use of artificial intelligence in horticulture has exacerbated the agribusiness revolution. Changes in the weather, an increase in the population, difficulties finding work, and concerns about food safety have all had an impact on this generation's crop yield. Crop yields in this day and age are influenced by a wide range of factors, including employment issues, food security, population growth, and climate change. Examining the numerous human-made reasoning applications in horticulture, such as water system, weeding, and showering, in conjunction with sensors and other robot-related apparatus is the primary challenge of the report. Pesticide and herbicide use could be reduced, soil fertility could be maintained, more water could be saved, and service quality could be improved with these technologies. Implementation of farming's robotization, which includes using robots to weed structures and use of robots. Computerized weeding and various soil water sensing techniques are discussed. This paper also discusses the various applications of drones for crop spraying and tracking.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lung Cancer Detection and Prediction With SVM Classifier Through Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Carcinoma is a disease that can affect any region of the body and is caused by the uncontrolled division of abnormal cells. It dominates the list of deadly diseases and is present everywhere, but it is still growing. In the majority of cases, lung cancer early identification is difficult. This study aims for a fruitful approach to lung cancer diagnosis. The pictures used in this study were generated from computed tomography scans of the lungs retrieved from pulmonary image archives. Methods of image processing like separating features and segments were used. In this method, a suitable combination of an adapted thresholding division algorithm, an established supported vector machine classification algorithm, and a content-driven image extraction technique have been utilised to evaluate features of lung images like agreement, magnitude, appearance, and shape. To obtain more precise and accurate prediction results, a set of patient-specific data is added, and it is handled using data mining techniques. Utilising open-source datasets and the mathematical modelling tool, the suggested segment method demonstrates superior results for prediction.

articleTitle: Integrated Webapp For Campus Placement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Many institutions now do not have a platform where students can view all of the offers from various firms, and they must fill out the form with their information again for each company that visits. To minimize future problems, the college placement department must check each student's information. Companies rely on the Placement department to obtain information about selected applicants for additional procedures. To solve this problem, a platform for students to register and submit their updated profiles was required. Companies can see the applications received for a specific job vacancy, admin can approve or reject the student's registration based on the database present with him, and students can see various job openings from companies at a specific time. The current system is not a proper and appropriate method of implementing Training and Placement management because it becomes difficult for the placement department to manage all of the databases, send emails regarding offers to every student, and keep track of every student, whether they received an offer or not. As a result, this study created a platform for students to register and submit their updated profiles, reducing administrative effort. Companies get immediate access to the applications submitted for a specific employment opportunity. Features are supplied to immediately generate information from existing data. This study recommended segmenting the web app into three components for design: admin, company, and student. React JS is utilized as a frontend framework for development, Node JS as a server-side script for integration and REST operations, MongoDB and Mongoose for databases and connections, Redux for state management, and Axios for requests and answers.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of A Bio-Inspired Robot Arm: Machine learning, Robot vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This research highlights a method for remotely controlling a highly complex humanoid robot that relies on the operator’s bio-signals The framework combines machine learning, robot vision, and collision avoidance to ensure safe interaction with the environment. This occurs even with rather noisy control signals, such as the acceleration and electromyography (EMG) data from the operator’s hands. Similar actions, such as reaching for and grasping objects, may be performed with the 5-DOF arm with the use of bio-signals.

articleTitle: Building a Deep Learning Model to Facilitate Software Project Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Software companies strive to create software projects of superior quality by leveraging the most optimal global resources at the most competitive cost. We implemented a methodology to attain global software development (GSD). Utilizing a method that involves collaborating on projects across various geographically dispersed locations, commonly called distributed development, is recommended. Companies encounter multiple challenges when they endeavour to implement Global Software Development (GSD) due to the inherent characteristics of GSD and its distinctions from conventional methodologies. Constructing a structure for machine learning to aid technology project risk analysis. The study's results indicate that 15 key factors significantly impact software projects in the context of GSD. Experimental analysis reveals that logistic regression and random forest models yield the most favourable outcomes, achieving 88% and 80% accuracy, respectively. Both models have a 71% and 72% area under the curve

articleTitle: Inspired by Social-Spider Behavior for Microwave Filter Optimization, Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: In this research, our researchers suggest using a contemporary swarm optimization approach for microwave filter optimization dubbed Social Spider Optimization (SSO), which is based on modeling social spiders’ cooperative actions. PSO (particle swarm optimization) and teaching-learning-based optimization (TLBO) are two evolutionary algorithms that demonstrate their efficacy and resilience compared to this optimization. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the recommended approach.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis Used to Find Local Events by Analysing social media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Over the last decade, scholars have paid much attention to sentiment analysis, the automatic extraction of statements is either favourable or adverse. In addition, the number of internet users who voiced their views through online review sites, social networks, and personal blogs has been rising rapidly in tandem with the emergence of these technologies. They have strong, favourable and unfavourable opinions about many groups of people, institutions, locations, and topics. It is now feasible to begin extracting feelings from social media to the tools given by natural language processing, deep learning, and other ways to deal with massive quantities of text. Discuss some of the challenges in opinion obtaining and some of the measures that have been taken to overcome these challenges, and present a technique to evaluate Twitter interpersonal sentiments that provides output outside just the polarity but uses those opposing forces in item targeting, trend analysis, and forecasting. The results suggest the strategy may be modified by analyzing the general public on social media to better suit the needs of the business sector.

articleTitle: A Prototype for Machine Learning Model Deployment in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Training and developing a Machine Learning (ML) model is a difficult task, and then after successfully creating a working model, deploying and distribution is an added feature. In most instances, those models are never deployed. To help with this, we present a prototype, a SaaS platform to allow users to dynamically deploy their machine learning models to the cloud and host them so that the user has complete control over the visibility and accessibility.This delivery and deployment model provides lower upfront cost, timely updates, and a dedicated work/host environment. The platform’s sole purpose revolves around the idea of a sharable deployable and ready to use Machine Learning Model. It takes advantage of the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery archetype facilitated by Kubernetes to dynamically provide custom and updated with the latest libraries docker environment.

articleTitle: Design of Efficient Built-in Self-Test Technique for Faulty TCAM Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The increasing demand for high-speed pattern matching in modern network devices has propelled the widespread adoption of Ternary Content Addressable Memory (TCAM) technology. However, ensuring the reliability and correctness of TCAMs remains a significant challenge due to the inherent susceptibility of memory cells to various types of faults. Memory Built-in Self-Test (BIST) techniques have emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by enabling efficient testing of TCAMs without external test equipment. This work presents a comprehensive overview of Memory BIST techniques specifically designed for TCAMs. The primary objective of TCAM-BIST is to detect and diagnose faults in TCAM arrays, such as single-cell stuck-at faults, coupling faults, and data-dependent faults. The TCAM-BIST, including deterministic and LFSR based pseudo-random pattern generators, multiple input signature register with space comparator-based fault detection mechanisms, and built-in self-repair techniques. Moreover, the research will explore the utilization of a multiple input signature register with a space comparator for efficient fault detection in TCAM-BIST. The MISR-based mechanism will be analyzed in terms of its ability to accurately detect and diagnose faults in TCAM arrays, while considering the impact on test time and hardware resources.

articleTitle: Lightweight DDoS Attack Detection and Mitigation in Software-Defined Networks Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Security is becoming more critical in the age of Software Defined Networking (SDN). Distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks, which suck up all available network and server bandwidth as well as controller and switch storage, may be launched by hackers taking advantage of security holes in SDN. This article details the planning and execution of security for SDN networks for identifying and counteracting cyber-attacks. The SDN security system has an anomaly detection and prevention module. The Convolution Neural Network model for Multilayer Perceptions (CNN-MLP) employs low-cost hybrid deep learning algorithms for traffic anomaly identification. Using the mitigation approach, the IP address of the attacker may be determined, and the controller’s flow rule commands can be used to stop any malicious traffic. Next, we analyze the SDN’s safeguards. The results of the tests show that the SDN security system can identify and stop DDoS traffic in real-time.

articleTitle: Green Commuting Strategies for Corporate Sustainability for Optimized Reduction of CO2 Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Sustainable employee transportation within organizations has emerged as a pivotal focal point, driven by businesses’ aspirations to curtail their carbon footprint, enhance employee well-being, and optimize operational expenditures. This study delves into the realm of sustainable employee transportation, shedding light on its paramount significance in the contemporary corporate landscape. The research embarks on an exploration of diverse strategies and initiatives that organizations have embraced to champion sustainable commuting choices among their workforce. These encompass the embrace of environmentally conscious commuting alternatives, including carpooling, cycling, public transit utilization, and the adoption of telecommuting practices. Furthermore, the study scrutinizes the role of cutting- edge technology and intelligent transportation solutions in facilitating sustainable employee commuting experiences. Moreover, this paper underscores the myriad advantages associated with sustainable transportation practices. These benefits encompass a marked reduction in greenhouse gas emissions, tangible cost savings, the promotion of improved employee health and productivity, and the alignment of organizational objectives with overarching sustainability targets. In addition, potential impediments and challenges that organizations might encounter when instituting sustainable transportation programs are thoroughly examined. Drawing insights from a spectrum of case studies and industry best practices, this research elucidates successful approaches for fostering sustainable employee transportation. It underscores the pivotal roles played by corporate leadership, employee engagement, and the formulation of comprehensive transportation policies in realizing meaningful and enduring sustainability outcomes. In summation, this study underscores the imperativeness for organizations to accord precedence to sustain- able transportation as an indispensable facet of their corporate social responsibility endeavors. In doing so, they contribute to a future characterized by environmental consciousness, improved well-being, and enhanced operational efficiency, benefiting not only their enterprises but also the broader communities they serve.

articleTitle: Integration of Machine Learning and Computer Vision to Detect and Prevent the Crime
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Intentionally harming an individual’s physical or mental wellness or destroying their property is a crime that leads to punishment by the state or the concerned authority. Protection-related crimes are rising, and agencies are under increasing pressure to react effectively. Due to the rising crime rate and the inefficiency of traditional crime-solving procedures, they are no longer viable options. If the crime is predicted accurately beforehand or build a mechanism that would support police, this would reduce the burden on law enforcement and help with crime prevention through the implementation of Machine Learning (ML) and computer vision(CV) algorithms and methods. This paper presents the results of a few cases in which such approaches have been utilised and how those results prompted one to do more research. The fundamental reason for the change in criminal detection and avoidance strategies is that people have seen law enforcement using these methods. The study aims to learn how ML and computer vision may help law enforcement to detect, prevent, and solve criminal activity. A new age in policing might be horizon if ML and CV methods become the norm.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Deep Learning - YouTube Video Recommendation Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: YouTube is one of the most widely used and technically advanced commercial systems of recommendations. It provides an overview of the system and highlights the remarkable gains in efficiency made possible by deep learning. This research uses the traditional “two-stage” framework for separating and retrieving information. First, a profound model for generating candidates ought to be described, and then a model for ranking candidates ought to be outlined, and both of these should be done in that order. The order in which these two tasks ought to be completed is important. In addition, it offers instruction that can be put into practice as well as valuable insights that have been gleaned from the process of developing, iterating, and managing a large-scale recommendation system that has a significant impact on the experience of the user.

articleTitle: Chandrayaan-3: Challenges and Opportunities of using AI to Detect and Identify Exoplanets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Exoplanets (planets beyond our solar system) have become a focal point in the field of astronomy and space exploration due to their potential to provide insights into planetary formation, habitability, and the possibility of extraterrestrial life. Though there are many prediction methods and models to detect exoplanets in the galaxy, but we need effective techniques to predict, detect and classify new exoplanets. The successful launch of the Chandrayaan-3, by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), has given confidence to the astronomic scientists that exoplanets can be effectively detected, identified, and analysed using the Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based spacecraft. In the Chandrayaan-3 project, AI has played a very important role for the spacecraft in launching, navigating, predicting, anomaly detecting, optimising mission operations, data processing and communication. This article presents a brief survey and overview on the opportunities and challenges of using AI to detect and identify exoplanets.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms to Visualize the Weld Quality and Evaluation of Health Issues during the Welding
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This research explores the potential of machine learning methods to use in the welding sector. Welding operations encounter several challenges that might use machine learning approaches. Welding processes have been found to benefit greatly from the use of machine learning algorithms, which increase both productivity and quality. Industrial robots powered by artificial intelligence may assist in addressing many difficult problems in the manufacturing industry. Many welding procedures depend on human knowledge to choose optimal settings, making them less efficient and more prone to human mistakes. To lessen this reliance, neural networks educate robots and autonomous systems to provide consistent weld quality and increased efficiency. Weld quality is mainly determined by visual examination. As a result, machine learning is also used to provide a visual representation of the welding process. In two dimensions, 12 machine learning pipelines are built: settings for feature engineering and ML techniques. Four feature settings and three machine learning methods were considered. Using data from two active industrial production lines containing 25 welding machines, a machine-learning pipeline was tested. These approaches may also be used to analyze the components using regression analysis to determine which factors relate to certain health concerns.

articleTitle: Lung Cancer Prediction using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The introduction of deep learning has had a profound impact on medical research, providing priceless insights and disease-specific prognostic skills. By improving the detection of lung nodules, deep learning techniques, in particular Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have revolutionized the field of medical sciences. Our study aims to take advantage of deep learning’s amazing potential for detecting malignant lung nodules in CT scan pictures. We have adopted an ensemble strategy to efficiently address this difficulty, integrating many CNN models to improve their performance and forecast accuracy. The cancerous CT scan dataset, readily accessible through their website, has proven instrumental in our efforts. The CT scan pictures in this dataset, which have been enhanced with important annotations, act as an important training set for our deep learning model. Deep learning uses Artificial Neural Networks to uncover patterns in complicated and nuanced data, drawing inspiration from the intricate operation of neurons in the human brain.We carefully selected a sizable CT scan dataset and used it to train our model. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are trained using this dataset to distinguish between malignant and non- malignant photos for use in medical diagnosis. In order to conduct a thorough evaluation, we have thoughtfully partitioned the dataset into distinct sets for training, validation, and testing. These meticulously crafted datasets play a crucial role in training and assessing our LungNet, which encompasses three distinct CNNs featuring varying layers, kernels, and pooling techniques. The created LungNet model exhibits training and validation accuracy of 88.13% and 84.85%, respectively. In order to find the best method, deep architectures like InceptionNet, MobileNet, ResNet, VGG, and XceptionNet were thoroughly evaluated both with and without transfer learning.

articleTitle: Contemporary Entertainment Mediums: An Analysis of Consumer Behavior
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This study delves into the dynamic realm of consumer behavior concerning contemporary entertainment mediums. The way that consumers interact with entertainment has significantly changed in an era of rapid technological advancement. This research seeks to comprehend the intricate interplay of factors that influence consumer preferences, choices, and consumption patterns in the modern entertainment landscape. Through a comprehensive analysis of consumer attitudes, motivations, and behaviors, we aim to shed light on the drivers shaping the consumption of digital content, streaming services, gaming platforms, and other emerging mediums. Our findings offer valuable insights for industry stakeholders, marketers, and content creators seeking to adapt and thrive in this evolving entertainment ecosystem.

articleTitle: IOT & Machine Learning Models to Develop The Architecture For Assessment Of Security Threats.
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) and other recent advancements in communication and information technology have profoundly impacted and enhanced people’s quality of life. IoT systems are vulnerable to previously unanticipated cyber threats such as denial of service, jamming, phishing, obfuscations eavesdropping, spoofing and invasions because of the widespread availability and rising demand for connected devices. The emerging cyber-physical security problem is difficult to avoid and guard against using conventional methods. Securing IoT systems calls for robust, dynamic, and current security mechanisms. When addressing emerging security concerns in cyber-physical systems (CPS), machine learning (ML) technology is often regarded as the most cutting- edge and promising option. This literature review explains how IoTs are built, looks into the many threats they face, and discusses the most up-to-date efforts being made to ensure their security using machine learning. In addition, it covers some of the research obstacles that may arise in the future while trying to implement security measures in IoT infrastructure.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Machine and Deep Learning Models in Dysrhythmia Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This study presents the quantitative analysis of machine learning and deep learning models in dysrhythmia classification. Existing dysrhythmia classification systems suffer from limited accuracy and adoption by healthcare professionals. This issue encouraged many researchers to adopt machine learning and deep learning models, but these systems don’t demonstrate clear dominance of machine learning and deep learning models. Hence the proposed modified convolution neural network model and comparative study provides a valuable compass for researchers, practitioners, and healthcare professionals, supplying a consolidated understanding of the state-of-the-art and offering a roadmap for further advancements in the pursuit of precise and efficient dysrhythmia classification.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Lightweight Authentication and Key Exchange Protocol For Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: The proposed authentication and key exchange protocol for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)are based on a combination of elliptic curve cryptography, symmetric cryptography, and blockchain technology. The protocol, called Blockchain-based Lightweight Authentication and Key exchange Protocol, aims to provide secure and efficient communication between the UAV and the ground station while minimizing computational costs and reducing the risk of cyber attacks. The elliptic curve cryptography is used for key exchange, symmetric cryptography is used for message encryption and decryption, and blockchain technology is used to store and distribute the public keys. The proposed protocol is evaluated through simulations and equated with current protocols. The outcomes show that the protocol has lower computational overhead, better security, and is highly resistant to attacks due to the use of blockchain technology. This makes the proposed protocol a suitable solution for secure communication in UAV applications. The paper builds on previous work such as DroneSecand DroneSec – lite, which is also based on elliptic curve cryptography and symmetric cryptography, but with a focus on lightweight authentication and key exchange protocols for UAV systems with varying computational capabilities.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Trust Management Scheme Over the Spatiotemporal Features of Software-Defined Vehicle Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Vehicle ad hoc networks (VANETs) have a lot of promise for enhancing traffic flow and addressing driving safety, however, they have not yet fully matured. The recent architecture cannot keep up with the swiftly expanding demand for cars as the number of intelligent vehicles rises. Additionally, the open character of VANET encourages unfair competition between vehicles. A trust evaluation and management method is developed based on the software-defined vehicle network (SDVN) architecture to address these issues and enhance the network performance of vehicular communication. The trust evaluation method considers vehicles’ spatiotemporal properties to control and standardize their behavior, improving the precision of malicious behavior detection. To promise the security of vehicle data and enhance the effectiveness of trust value updates and inquiries, the mechanism also suggests a trust management technique based on Hyper ledger Fabric, a blockchain-based consortium chain. Message consistency and security are ensured in the SDVN network by the proposed trust management mechanism, which also speeds up consensus and improves trust management’s overall effectiveness, according to experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Assessment of Skills Street Vendors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: This article addresses street vendors’ excessive working hours, poor workplace safety and security conditions, together with the illegal compensation they must pay to local authorities. The article also examines socioeconomic background, challenges and handling strategies, urban authority, street vendors, the activity’s contribution to operators’ livelihood security, and diversification strategies article’s background is to bring out the demographic and socioeconomic conditions of males and females and sort out various challenges faced in running business of street vendors in Dindigul Districts. Furthermore, 150 street vendors were surveyed through personal interviews, and primary data was collected through an unbiased questionnaire. In Statistical Packages for Social Sciences (SPSS), the researcher used bar diagrams, frequency tables, pie-diagrams, regression and Chisquare. Among the skill sets of street vendors, the researcher assessed potentiality concerning the following skills such as negotiation, knowledge management, merchandising, resource management, finance management and customer relationship management.

Author Keywords: Finance expertise and customer relationship management

articleTitle: Privacy and Security using Double Signature Based Cryptocraphy using DS-SHA256 in Cloud Cimputing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a popular technology that offers clients various services remotely daily. Nowadays, cloud computing is becoming a fast-growing industry that contains the potential to provide extensible services via the internet using software and hardware virtualization. It has become difficult for cloud companies to manage the enormous volume of data and diverse resources in the cloud due to its rapid growth. Most clients range from individual users to large corporations or business houses. To prevent over-provisioning and under-provisioning problems, it is essential to ensure the availability of the resources to the end user with the least amount of administration. As a result, resources must be equitably distributed among various stakeholders without sacrificing the organization’s profitability or customer satisfaction. The enormous load from dynamic sources with various formats makes resource allocation and scheduling a complex process.It also leads to several security issues, which include privacy, interoperability, credibility, following critical standards, and collaborations become a significant concern in cloud computing. We proposed cloud service provider dynamic scheduling (CSPDS) to address these issues. The proposed system is efficiently designed to handle various formats and huge loads in the cloud environment. The cloud service provider (CSP) plays a primary role in our proposed methodology (CSPDS), which controls and monitors the entire network. The CSPDS enhances the network’s QoS (quality of service) in resource monitoring, resource utilization, and resource allocation. Next, the migration model provides the best resource utilization, and the cryptography modules improve the users’ overall data security in the cloud. Finally, in the experimental section, a comparison work is conducted between the proposed CSPDS with existing resource allocation& task scheduling using a hybrid machine learning (RATS-HM) [13] technique and Resource Allocation Algorithm (RAA)[14]. In the comparison work, these algorithms are analyzed with evaluation metrics such as utilization, system efficiency, migration time, and security performance. The obtained results state in all the metrics that the proposed CSPDS performance is more efficient than the others.

articleTitle: A Secure Trust Model for Hybrid FANET Including Flying and Stationary Nodes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: FANETs (Flying Ad-hoc networks) ARE a type of ad-hoc networks that involve drones communicating with each other and forming a network. Such a network has multiple applications like providing last mile connectivity when there are not enough nodes, where nodes are too far apart, or terrain causes signals to be obstructed. Also, they can be used in areas where a natural disaster has destroyed network infrastructure to provide connectivity. Due to hardware, quality of service and other limitations, trust models developed for traditional wired/wireless networks are found to be inappropriate. abstract: The prediction of weather has always been an integral factor in our lives as it determines if the day of activity leads to favorable or unfavorable conditions. articleTitle: Leveraging the Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques to Detect Breast Cancer Earlier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on New Frontiers in Communication, Automation, Management and Security (ICCAMS)
abstract: Worldwide the Breast cancer is a major reason of cancer-related mortalities among women. This research aims to compare Support Vector Machines (SVM), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) as potential models for breast cancer detection using full mammogram images from the CBIS DDSM dataset. The primary objective is to identify early-stage breast cancer and classify images as Calcification or Mass by extracting relevant features from mammograms. Given the image processing nature of this study, CNN offers a distinct advantage, as it can autonomously learn intricate features from mammogram images through its multiple convolutional layers. In contrast, SVM employs the kernel function to classify images by extracting features, while RNN excels in capturing temporal dependencies in sequential data, making it valuable for cancer detection. The evaluation of these models relies on the confusion matrix, providing insights into correct and incorrect classifications of Cancerous and Non-Cancerous images. The essential metrics, like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, are utilized to get the performances of each model. The study's findings reveal that CNN achieves the high accuracy rate. This comparative analysis sheds light on the strengths and limitations of both Machine Learning (SVM) and Deep Learning models (CNN and RNN) in the context of early breast cancer detection.
